"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { CalendarIcon, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  BS_MAX_YEAR,
  BS_MIN_YEAR,
  BS_WEEKDAYS_EN,
  BS_WEEKDAYS_NE,
  adToBs,
  bsToAd,
  compareBs,
  formatBs,
  formatBsLong,
  getBsMonthName,
  getBsMonthStartWeekday,
  getDaysInBsMonth,
  localizeDigits,
  parseBs,
  todayBs,
  type BsDate,
  type BsLang,
} from "@/lib/bs-date";
import Button from "./ui/button";

type View = { year: number; month: number };

const ymIndex = (v: View) => v.year * 12 + (v.month - 1);

export interface BsDatePickerProps
  extends Omit<
    React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Button>,
    "value" | "onChange" | "onBlur" | "children" | "type" | "placeholder"
  > {
  /**
   * Either a BS date string "YYYY-MM-DD" or a JS `Date` (AD).
   * Empty: "" / undefined / null.
   */
  value?: string | Date | null;
  /**
   * Emits a BS string "YYYY-MM-DD" (cleared: ""), or a JS `Date` (cleared: undefined)
   * when `valueFormat="ad"` or when the current `value` is a Date.
   */
  onChange?: (value: string | Date | undefined) => void;
  onBlur?: () => void;
  /**
   * What onChange emits. "bs" = BS string, "ad" = JS Date.
   * Default: "ad" if `value` is currently a Date, otherwise "bs".
   * If your form field type is `Date | undefined` (e.g. z.date()), pass valueFormat="ad".
   */
  valueFormat?: "bs" | "ad";
  placeholder?: string;
  /** "en" = Roman month names + digits, "ne" = Devanagari. */
  lang?: BsLang;
  /** Earliest selectable date: BS string "YYYY-MM-DD" or a JS Date. */
  minDate?: string | Date;
  /** Latest selectable date: BS string "YYYY-MM-DD" or a JS Date. */
  maxDate?: string | Date;
  /** Show a "Clear" button when a date is selected. Default true. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Show the AD equivalent of the selected date. Default true. */
  showAd?: boolean;
}

export const BsDatePicker = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, BsDatePickerProps>(
  function BsDatePicker(
    {
      value,
      onChange,
      onBlur,
      valueFormat,
      placeholder,
      lang = "en",
      minDate,
      maxDate,
      clearable = true,
      showAd = true,
      className,
      disabled,
      ...buttonProps
    },
    ref,
  ) {
    const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

    // Date objects are compared by timestamp so a new-but-equal Date doesn't recompute.
    const valueKey = value instanceof Date ? value.getTime() : value;
    const minKey = minDate instanceof Date ? minDate.getTime() : minDate;
    const maxKey = maxDate instanceof Date ? maxDate.getTime() : maxDate;

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    const selected = React.useMemo(() => toBs(value), [valueKey]);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    const minBound = React.useMemo(() => toBs(minDate), [minKey]);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    const maxBound = React.useMemo(() => toBs(maxDate), [maxKey]);

    const emit = (d: BsDate | null) => {
      const asAd = valueFormat ? valueFormat === "ad" : value instanceof Date;
      if (d === null) onChange?.(asAd ? undefined : "");
      else onChange?.(asAd ? bsToAd(d) : formatBs(d));
    };

    const low: View = React.useMemo(
      () => (minBound ? { year: minBound.year, month: minBound.month } : { year: BS_MIN_YEAR, month: 1 }),
      [minBound],
    );
    const high: View = React.useMemo(() => {
      const h = maxBound ? { year: maxBound.year, month: maxBound.month } : { year: BS_MAX_YEAR, month: 12 };
      // Guard against an inverted min/max range (e.g. start date later than the max).
      return ymIndex(h) < ymIndex(low) ? low : h;
    }, [maxBound, low]);

    const clampView = React.useCallback(
      (v: View): View => {
        if (ymIndex(v) < ymIndex(low)) return low;
        if (ymIndex(v) > ymIndex(high)) return high;
        return v;
      },
      [low, high],
    );

    const initialView = React.useCallback((): View => {
      const base = selected ?? todayBs();
      return clampView({ year: base.year, month: base.month });
    }, [selected, clampView]);

    const [view, setView] = React.useState<View>(initialView);

    const handleOpenChange = (next: boolean) => {
      setOpen(next);
      if (next) setView(initialView());
      else onBlur?.();
    };

    const today = React.useMemo(() => todayBs(), []);

    const isDisabled = (d: BsDate) =>
      (minBound !== null && compareBs(d, minBound) < 0) ||
      (maxBound !== null && compareBs(d, maxBound) > 0);

    const select = (d: BsDate) => {
      emit(d);
      setOpen(false);
      onBlur?.();
    };

    const goMonth = (delta: number) => {
      const idx = ymIndex(view) + delta;
      setView(clampView({ year: Math.floor(idx / 12), month: (idx % 12) + 1 }));
    };

    const daysInMonth = getDaysInBsMonth(view.year, view.month);
    const lead = getBsMonthStartWeekday(view.year, view.month);
    const cells: Array<number | null> = [
      ...Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null),
      ...Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => i + 1),
    ];

    const years = Array.from({ length: high.year - low.year + 1 }, (_, i) => low.year + i);
    const monthStart = view.year === low.year ? low.month : 1;
    const monthEnd = view.year === high.year ? high.month : 12;
    const months = Array.from({ length: monthEnd - monthStart + 1 }, (_, i) => monthStart + i);

    const weekdays = lang === "ne" ? BS_WEEKDAYS_NE : BS_WEEKDAYS_EN;
    const resolvedPlaceholder =
      placeholder ?? (lang === "ne" ? "मिति छान्नुहोस्" : "Select date (BS)");

    return (
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <Button
            ref={ref}
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={disabled}
            className={cn(
              "w-full justify-start text-left font-normal",
              !selected && "text-muted-foreground",
              className,
            )}
            {...buttonProps}
          >
            <CalendarIcon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            {selected ? formatBsLong(selected, lang) : <span>{resolvedPlaceholder}</span>}
          </Button>
        </PopoverTrigger>

        <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-3" align="start">
          {/* Header: prev / month / year / next */}
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="icon"
              className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0"
              onClick={() => goMonth(-1)}
              disabled={ymIndex(view) <= ymIndex(low)}
              aria-label="Previous month"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Select
                value={String(view.month)}
                onValueChange={(v) => setView(clampView({ ...view, month: Number(v) }))}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-[110px] px-2 text-sm" aria-label="Month">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {months.map((m) => (
                    <SelectItem key={m} value={String(m)}>
                      {getBsMonthName(m, lang)}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>

              <Select
                value={String(view.year)}
                onValueChange={(v) => setView(clampView({ ...view, year: Number(v) }))}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-[90px] px-2 text-sm" aria-label="Year">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-64">
                  {years.map((y) => (
                    <SelectItem key={y} value={String(y)}>
                      {localizeDigits(y, lang)}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="icon"
              className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0"
              onClick={() => goMonth(1)}
              disabled={ymIndex(view) >= ymIndex(high)}
              aria-label="Next month"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Weekday header (week starts Sunday; Saturday is the Nepali weekly holiday) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
            {weekdays.map((w, i) => (
              <div
                key={w}
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-8 w-9 items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground",
                  i === 6 && "text-destructive",
                )}
              >
                {w}
              </div>
            ))}

            {cells.map((day, idx) => {
              if (day === null) return <div key={`blank-${idx}`} className="h-9 w-9" />;

              const date: BsDate = { year: view.year, month: view.month, day };
              const isSelected = selected !== null && compareBs(date, selected) === 0;
              const isToday = compareBs(date, today) === 0;
              const isSaturday = (lead + day - 1) % 7 === 6;
              const off = isDisabled(date);

              return (
                <Button
                  key={day}
                  type="button"
                  variant={isSelected ? "primary" : "ghost"}
                  disabled={off}
                  onClick={() => select(date)}
                  aria-label={formatBsLong(date, "en")}
                  aria-pressed={isSelected}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-9 w-9 p-0 font-normal",
                    !isSelected && isSaturday && "text-destructive",
                    !isSelected && isToday && "bg-accent text-accent-foreground",
                    off && "opacity-40",
                  )}
                >
                  {localizeDigits(day, lang)}
                </Button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t pt-3">
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {showAd && selected ? <>AD: {formatAd(selected)}</> : null}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {clearable && selected ? (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="h-7 px-2 text-xs"
                  onClick={() => {
                    emit(null);
                    setOpen(false);
                    onBlur?.();
                  }}
                >
                  <X className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />
                  {lang === "ne" ? "हटाउनुहोस्" : "Clear"}
                </Button>
              ) : null}
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                className="h-7 px-2 text-xs"
                disabled={isDisabled(today)}
                onClick={() => select(today)}
              >
                {lang === "ne" ? "आज" : "Today"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    );
  },
);

/** BS string or JS Date (AD) -> BsDate; null when empty, invalid, or outside 2001-2095 BS. */
function toBs(v: string | Date | null | undefined): BsDate | null {
  if (v instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(v.getTime())) return null;
    try {
      return adToBs(v);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return parseBs(v);
}

function formatAd(d: BsDate): string {
  const ad = bsToAd(d);
  const y = ad.getFullYear();
  const m = String(ad.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(ad.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

// Re-exported for convenience in forms.
export { adToBs, bsToAd, formatBs, parseBs };

export function ChartAreaInteractive() {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = React.useState("90d")

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setTimeRange("7d")
    }
  }, [isMobile])

  const filteredData = chartData.filter((item) => {
    const date = new Date(item.date)
    const referenceDate = new Date("2024-06-30")
    let daysToSubtract = 90
    if (timeRange === "30d") {
      daysToSubtract = 30
    } else if (timeRange === "7d") {
      daysToSubtract = 7
    }
    const startDate = new Date(referenceDate)
    startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - daysToSubtract)
    return date >= startDate
  })

  return (
    <Card className="@container/card">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Total Visitors</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          <span className="hidden @[540px]/card:block">
            Total for the last 3 months
          </span>
          <span className="@[540px]/card:hidden">Last 3 months</span>
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          <ToggleGroup
            type="single"
            value={timeRange}
            onValueChange={setTimeRange}
            variant="outline"
            className="hidden *:data-[slot=toggle-group-item]:px-4! @[767px]/card:flex"
          >
            <ToggleGroupItem value="90d">Last 3 months</ToggleGroupItem>
            <ToggleGroupItem value="30d">Last 30 days</ToggleGroupItem>
            <ToggleGroupItem value="7d">Last 7 days</ToggleGroupItem>
          </ToggleGroup>
          <Select value={timeRange} onValueChange={setTimeRange}>
            <SelectTrigger
              className="flex w-40 **:data-[slot=select-value]:block **:data-[slot=select-value]:truncate @[767px]/card:hidden"
              size="sm"
              aria-label="Select a value"
            >
              <SelectValue placeholder="Last 3 months" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className="rounded-xl">
              <SelectItem value="90d" className="rounded-lg">
                Last 3 months
              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="30d" className="rounded-lg">
                Last 30 days
              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="7d" className="rounded-lg">
                Last 7 days
              </SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="px-2 pt-4 sm:px-6 sm:pt-6">
        <ChartContainer
          config={chartConfig}
          className="aspect-auto h-[250px] w-full"
        >
          <AreaChart data={filteredData}>
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="fillDesktop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop
                  offset="5%"
                  stopColor="var(--color-desktop)"
                  stopOpacity={1.0}
                />
                <stop
                  offset="95%"
                  stopColor="var(--color-desktop)"
                  stopOpacity={0.1}
                />
              </linearGradient>
              <linearGradient id="fillMobile" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop
                  offset="5%"
                  stopColor="var(--color-mobile)"
                  stopOpacity={0.8}
                />
                <stop
                  offset="95%"
                  stopColor="var(--color-mobile)"
                  stopOpacity={0.1}
                />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
            <XAxis
              dataKey="date"
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={false}
              tickMargin={8}
              minTickGap={32}
              tickFormatter={(value) => {
                const date = new Date(value)
                return date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
                  month: "short",
                  day: "numeric",

              }}
            />
            <ChartTooltip
              cursor={false}
              content={
                <ChartTooltipContent
                  labelFormatter={(value) => {
                    return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
                      month: "short",
                      day: "numeric",
                    })
                  }}
                  indicator="dot"
                />
              }
            />
            <Area
              dataKey="mobile"
              type="natural"
              fill="url(#fillMobile)"
              stroke="var(--color-mobile)"
              stackId="a"
            />
            <Area
              dataKey="desktop"
              type="natural"
              fill="url(#fillDesktop)"
              stroke="var(--color-desktop)"
              stackId="a"
            />
          </AreaChart>
        </ChartContainer>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  )
}

  );
}

      return <TableCellViewer item={row.original} />;
    },
    enableHiding: false,
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "type",
    header: "Section Type",
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <div className="w-32">
        <Badge variant="outline" className="px-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
          {row.original.type}
        </Badge>
      </div>
    ),
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "status",
    header: "Status",
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <Badge variant="outline" className="px-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
        {row.original.status === "Done" ? (
          <CircleCheckIcon className="fill-green-500 dark:fill-green-400" />
        ) : (
          <LoaderIcon />
        )}
        {row.original.status}
      </Badge>
    ),
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "target",
    header: () => <div className="w-full text-right">Target</div>,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          toast.promise(new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)), {
            loading: `Saving ${row.original.header}`,
            success: "Done",
            error: "Error",
          });
        }}
      >
        <Label htmlFor={`${row.original.id}-target`} className="sr-only">
          Target
        </Label>
        <Input
          className="h-8 w-16 border-transparent bg-transparent text-right shadow-none hover:bg-input/30 focus-visible:border focus-visible:bg-background dark:bg-transparent dark:hover:bg-input/30 dark:focus-visible:bg-input/30"
          defaultValue={row.original.target}
          id={`${row.original.id}-target`}
        />
      </form>
    ),
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "limit",
    header: () => <div className="w-full text-right">Limit</div>,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          toast.promise(new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)), {
            loading: `Saving ${row.original.header}`,
            success: "Done",
            error: "Error",
          });
        }}
      >
        <Label htmlFor={`${row.original.id}-limit`} className="sr-only">
          Limit
        </Label>
        <Input
          className="h-8 w-16 border-transparent bg-transparent text-right shadow-none hover:bg-input/30 focus-visible:border focus-visible:bg-background dark:bg-transparent dark:hover:bg-input/30 dark:focus-visible:bg-input/30"
          defaultValue={row.original.limit}
          id={`${row.original.id}-limit`}
        />
      </form>
    ),
  },
  {
    accessorKey: "reviewer",
    header: "Reviewer",
    cell: ({ row }) => {
      const isAssigned = row.original.reviewer !== "Assign reviewer";

      if (isAssigned) {
        return row.original.reviewer;
      }

      return (
        <>
          <Label htmlFor={`${row.original.id}-reviewer`} className="sr-only">
            Reviewer
          </Label>
          <Select>
            <SelectTrigger
              className="w-38 **:data-[slot=select-value]:block **:data-[slot=select-value]:truncate"
              size="sm"
              id={`${row.original.id}-reviewer`}
            >
              <SelectValue placeholder="Assign reviewer" />

                </SelectItem>

          </Select>
        </>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    id: "actions",
    cell: () => (

        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>

            variant="ghost"

            size="icon"
          >
            <EllipsisVerticalIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">Open menu</span>
          </Button>

          <DropdownMenuItem>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>

          <DropdownMenuItem>Favorite</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
    ),

];

function DraggableRow({ row }: { row: Row<z.infer<typeof schema>> }) {
  const { transform, transition, setNodeRef, isDragging } = useSortable({
    id: row.original.id,
  });

  return (
    <TableRow
      data-state={row.getIsSelected() && "selected"}
      data-dragging={isDragging}
      ref={setNodeRef}
      className="relative z-0 data-[dragging=true]:z-10 data-[dragging=true]:opacity-80"
      style={{
        transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
        transition: transition,
      }}
    >
      {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
        <TableCell key={cell.id}>
          {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
        </TableCell>
      ))}
    </TableRow>
  );
}

export function DataTable({
  data: initialData,
}: {
  data: z.infer<typeof schema>[];
}) {
  const [data, setData] = React.useState(() => initialData);
  const [rowSelection, setRowSelection] = React.useState({});
  const [columnVisibility, setColumnVisibility] =
    React.useState<VisibilityState>({});
  const [columnFilters, setColumnFilters] = React.useState<ColumnFiltersState>(
    [],
  );
  const [sorting, setSorting] = React.useState<SortingState>([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = React.useState({
    pageIndex: 0,
    pageSize: 10,
  });
  const sortableId = React.useId();
  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(MouseSensor, {}),
    useSensor(TouchSensor, {}),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {}),
  );

  const dataIds = React.useMemo<UniqueIdentifier[]>(
    () => data?.map(({ id }) => id) || [],
    [data],
  );

  const table = useReactTable({
    data,
    columns,
    state: {
      sorting,
      columnVisibility,
      rowSelection,
      columnFilters,
      pagination,
    },
    getRowId: (row) => row.id.toString(),
    enableRowSelection: true,
    onRowSelectionChange: setRowSelection,
    onSortingChange: setSorting,
    onColumnFiltersChange: setColumnFilters,
    onColumnVisibilityChange: setColumnVisibility,
    onPaginationChange: setPagination,
    getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
    getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
    getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    getFacetedRowModel: getFacetedRowModel(),
    getFacetedUniqueValues: getFacetedUniqueValues(),
  });

  function handleDragEnd(event: DragEndEvent) {
    const { active, over } = event;
    if (active && over && active.id !== over.id) {
      setData((data) => {
        const oldIndex = dataIds.indexOf(active.id);
        const newIndex = dataIds.indexOf(over.id);
        return arrayMove(data, oldIndex, newIndex);
      });
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tabs
      defaultValue="outline"
      className="w-full flex-col justify-start gap-6"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 lg:px-6">
        <Label htmlFor="view-selector" className="sr-only">
          View
        </Label>
        <Select defaultValue="outline">
          <SelectTrigger
            className="flex w-fit @4xl/main:hidden"
            size="sm"
            id="view-selector"
          >
            <SelectValue placeholder="Select a view" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectGroup>
              <SelectItem value="outline">Outline</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="past-performance">Past Performance</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="key-personnel">Key Personnel</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="focus-documents">Focus Documents</SelectItem>
            </SelectGroup>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <TabsList className="hidden **:data-[slot=badge]:size-5 **:data-[slot=badge]:rounded-full **:data-[slot=badge]:bg-muted-foreground/30 **:data-[slot=badge]:px-1 @4xl/main:flex">
          <TabsTrigger value="outline">Outline</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="past-performance">
            Past Performance <Badge variant="secondary">3</Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="key-personnel">
            Key Personnel <Badge variant="secondary">2</Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="focus-documents">Focus Documents</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                <Columns3Icon data-icon="inline-start" />
                Columns
                <ChevronDownIcon data-icon="inline-end" />
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-32">
              {table
                .getAllColumns()
                .filter(
                  (column) =>
                    typeof column.accessorFn !== "undefined" &&
                    column.getCanHide(),
                )
                .map((column) => {
                  return (
                    <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
                      key={column.id}
                      className="capitalize"
                      checked={column.getIsVisible()}
                      onCheckedChange={(value) =>
                        column.toggleVisibility(!!value)
                      }
                    >
                      {column.id}
                    </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
                  );
                })}
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
            <PlusIcon />
            <span className="hidden lg:inline">Add Section</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <TabsContent
        value="outline"
        className="relative flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-auto px-4 lg:px-6"
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
          <DndContext
            collisionDetection={closestCenter}
            modifiers={[restrictToVerticalAxis]}
            onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
            sensors={sensors}
            id={sortableId}
          >
            <Table>
              <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted">
                {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
                  <TableRow key={headerGroup.id}>
                    {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => {
                      return (
                        <TableHead key={header.id} colSpan={header.colSpan}>
                          {header.isPlaceholder
                            ? null
                            : flexRender(
                                header.column.columnDef.header,
                                header.getContext(),
                              )}
                        </TableHead>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody className="**:data-[slot=table-cell]:first:w-8">
                {table.getRowModel().rows?.length ? (
                  <SortableContext
                    items={dataIds}
                    strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                  >
                    {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                      <DraggableRow key={row.id} row={row} />
                    ))}
                  </SortableContext>
                ) : (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell
                      colSpan={columns.length}
                      className="h-24 text-center"
                    >
                      No results.
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </DndContext>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4">
          <div className="hidden flex-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground lg:flex">
            {table.getFilteredSelectedRowModel().rows.length} of{" "}
            {table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length} row(s) selected.
          </div>
          <div className="flex w-full items-center gap-8 lg:w-fit">
            <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 lg:flex">
              <Label htmlFor="rows-per-page" className="text-sm font-medium">
                Rows per page
              </Label>
              <Select
                value={`${table.getState().pagination.pageSize}`}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  table.setPageSize(Number(value));
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-20" id="rows-per-page">
                  <SelectValue
                    placeholder={table.getState().pagination.pageSize}
                  />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent side="top">
                  <SelectGroup>
                    {[10, 20, 30, 40, 50].map((pageSize) => (
                      <SelectItem key={pageSize} value={`${pageSize}`}>
                        {pageSize}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectGroup>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="flex w-fit items-center justify-center text-sm font-medium">
              Page {table.getState().pagination.pageIndex + 1} of{" "}
              {table.getPageCount()}
            </div>
            <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 lg:ml-0">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="hidden h-8 w-8 p-0 lg:flex"
                onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(0)}
                disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to first page</span>
                <ChevronsLeftIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="size-8"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.previousPage()}
                disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to previous page</span>
                <ChevronLeftIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="size-8"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.nextPage()}
                disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to next page</span>
                <ChevronRightIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="hidden size-8 lg:flex"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(table.getPageCount() - 1)}
                disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to last page</span>
                <ChevronsRightIcon />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent
        value="past-performance"
        className="flex flex-col px-4 lg:px-6"
      >
        <div className="aspect-video w-full flex-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed"></div>
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="key-personnel" className="flex flex-col px-4 lg:px-6">
        <div className="aspect-video w-full flex-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed"></div>
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent
        value="focus-documents"
        className="flex flex-col px-4 lg:px-6"
      >
        <div className="aspect-video w-full flex-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed"></div>
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import type { Label as LabelPrimitive } from "radix-ui";
import type { ControllerProps, FieldPath, FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import { Controller, FormProvider, useFormContext } from "react-hook-form";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

const Form = FormProvider;

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
> = {
  name: TName;
};

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue,
);

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  );
};

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext);
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext);
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext();

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState);

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>");
  }

  const { id } = itemContext;

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  };
};

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string;
};

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue,
);

function FormItem({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
  const id = React.useId();
  const { error } = useFormField();

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div
        data-slot="form-item"
        className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2.5", className)}
        data-invalid={!!error}
        {...props}
      />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  );
}

function FormLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root> & {
  isOptional?: boolean;
}) {
  const { formItemId } = useFormField();

  return (
    <p className="flex  items-center gap-1 leading-0">
      <Label
        data-slot="form-label"
        className={cn("font-medium text-foreground", className)}
        htmlFor={formItemId}
        {...props}
      />
      {!props.isOptional && <span className="text-destructive">*</span>}
    </p>
  );
}

function FormControl({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Slot>) {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } =
    useFormField();

  return (
    <Slot
      data-slot="form-control"
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function FormDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) {
  const { formDescriptionId, error } = useFormField();

  if (error) {
    return null; // Hide the description when there's an error
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-slot="form-description"
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-xs text-muted-foreground -mt-0.5", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function FormMessage({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>) {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField();
  const body = error ? String(error?.message) : children;

  if (!body) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-slot="form-message"
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn(
        "-mt-0.5 text-sm font-normal text-destructive leading-0 pt-0.5",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}

export {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
  useFormField,
};

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { PenSquare, Search, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { useDebounce } from "use-debounce";
import { cn, formatDate } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "./ui/table";
import Button from "@/components/ui/button";
import NoData from "./common/no-data";
import StatusBadge from "./ui/status-badge";
import PaginationControls from "./common/PaginationControls";

export type T_TableHead<T = any> = {
  /** Property to show. Supports dot paths for nested data, e.g. "category.name". */
  key: string;
  headName: string;
  /** Minimum width of the column in px. */
  minWidth?: number;
  /** Custom cell renderer (callback). Overrides default rendering for this column. */
  render?: (item: T, index: number) => ReactNode;
};

export type T_TablePagination = {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  total: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
};

type Props<T extends Record<string, any>> = {
  tableHeads: T_TableHead<T>[];
  data: T[];
  /**
   * Row callback: return an object keyed by each column's `key`, e.g.
   * { name: user.data.data.name, status: <Badge>...</Badge> }.
   * Each value can be a string, number, badge, or any React node.
   * Columns missing from the object fall back to their `render` or default display.
   */
  renderRow?: (item: T, index: number) => Record<string, ReactNode>;
  /** Return the route to open when the edit icon is clicked. */
  onEdit?: (item: T) => string;
  /** Called when the delete icon is clicked. */
  onDelete?: (item: T) => void;
  /** Pass `isLoading` from your useQuery to show skeleton rows. */
  isLoading?: boolean;
  /**
   * - omitted: rows are filtered in the browser across every column in `tableHeads`.
   * - provided: called (debounced) with the search text; table shows exactly `data`.
   *   Wrap it in useCallback so its identity stays stable.
   */
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  /** Server-side pagination. Footer is shown only when total > 0. */
  pagination?: T_TablePagination;
  emptyTitle?: string;
  emptyDescription?: string;
};

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(T[\d:.]+(Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?)?$/;
const isDateValue = (value: unknown): value is string =>
  typeof value === "string" && ISO_DATE.test(value);

/** Read `item[path]`, falling back to a dot-path walk ("category.name"). */
const getValue = (item: Record<string, any>, path: string): unknown => {
  if (path in item) return item[path];
  return path
    .split(".")
    .reduce<any>((acc, part) => (acc == null ? undefined : acc[part]), item);
};

const LABEL_KEYS = ["name", "title", "label"];

/** Collapse objects/arrays into something React can safely render. */
const toDisplayValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value
      .map(toDisplayValue)
      .filter((v) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== "")
      .join(", ");
  }

  if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
    const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const k of LABEL_KEYS) {
      const v = obj[k];
      if (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number") return v;
    }
    return "";
  }

  return value;
};

const stringify = (value: unknown) => {
  const v = toDisplayValue(value);
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? "active" : "inactive";
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
  return String(v).toLowerCase();
};

const renderValue = (raw: unknown): ReactNode => {
  const value = toDisplayValue(raw);

  if (typeof value === "boolean") return <StatusBadge status={value} />;
  if (isDateValue(value))
    return (
      <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
        {formatDate(value)}
      </span>
    );
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "")
    return <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>;

  return <span className="text-foreground/90">{String(value)}</span>;
};

const GenericTable = <T extends Record<string, any>>({
  tableHeads,
  data,
  renderRow,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  isLoading = false,
  onSearch,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search…",
  pagination,
  emptyTitle,
  emptyDescription,
}: Props<T>) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch] = useDebounce(search, 400);

  // Server-side mode: notify parent only when debounced text changes.
  const lastSent = useRef("");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onSearch || debouncedSearch === lastSent.current) return;
    lastSent.current = debouncedSearch;
    onSearch(debouncedSearch);
  }, [debouncedSearch, onSearch]);

  // Client-side mode: filter locally against every column.
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (onSearch) return data;
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return data;
    return data.filter((item) =>
      tableHeads.some((head) =>
        stringify(getValue(item, head.key)).includes(q),
      ),
    );
  }, [data, search, onSearch, tableHeads]);

  const hasActions = !!onEdit || !!onDelete;
  const colCount = tableHeads.length + 1 + (hasActions ? 1 : 0);

  const startIndex = pagination ? (pagination.page - 1) * pagination.limit : 0;
  const totalPages = pagination
    ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.limit))
    : 1;

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-3">
      {/* Search (native input) */}
      <div className="relative min-w-48 max-w-72">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 size-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
          aria-label="Search table"
          className={cn(
            "h-8 w-full rounded-md pl-8 pr-8 text-sm",
            "border border-border bg-background",
            "text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground",
            "focus:border-ring/60 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring/40",
            "transition-colors",
          )}
        />
        {search && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSearch("")}
            aria-label="Clear search"
            className="absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 flex size-5 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <X className="size-3" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Table card: always full size, with or without rows */}
      <div className="flex min-h-80 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-auto">
          <div className="shrink-0 [&>div]:overflow-visible">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="bg-muted/50 hover:bg-muted/50">
                  <TableHead className="w-12 min-w-12 border-r text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground/70">
                    SN
                  </TableHead>
                  {tableHeads.map((head) => (
                    <TableHead
                      key={head.key}
                      style={{ minWidth: head.minWidth }}
                      className="border-r text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground/70"
                    >
                      {head.headName}
                    </TableHead>
                  ))}
                  {hasActions && (
                    <TableHead className="w-24 text-center text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground/70">
                      Actions
                    </TableHead>
                  )}
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>

              <TableBody>
                {isLoading &&
                  Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                    <TableRow
                      key={i}
                      className="animate-pulse hover:bg-transparent"
                    >
                      {Array.from({ length: colCount }).map((_, j) => (
                        <TableCell key={j}>
                          <div
                            className="h-4 rounded bg-muted"
                            style={{ width: `${55 + ((j * 37) % 35)}%` }}
                          />
                        </TableCell>
                      ))}
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}

                {!isLoading &&
                  rows.map((item, index) => {
                    const cells = renderRow?.(item, startIndex + index);
                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={item.id ?? index}
                        className="group transition-colors"
                      >
                        <TableCell className="w-12 min-w-12 border-b border-r text-center text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                          {startIndex + index + 1}
                        </TableCell>

                        {tableHeads.map((head) => {
                          const custom = cells?.[head.key];
                          return (
                            <TableCell
                              key={head.key}
                              style={{ minWidth: head.minWidth }}
                              className="max-w-[20rem] truncate border-b border-r text-sm"
                            >
                              {custom !== undefined
                                ? custom
                                : head.render
                                  ? head.render(item, startIndex + index)
                                  : renderValue(getValue(item, head.key))}
                            </TableCell>
                          );
                        })}

                        {hasActions && (
                          <TableCell className="w-24 border-b text-right">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                              {onEdit && (
                                <Link
                                  to={onEdit(item)}
                                  aria-label={`Edit row ${startIndex + index + 1}`}
                                  className="inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary"
                                >
                                  <PenSquare className="size-3.5" />
                                </Link>
                              )}
                              {onDelete && (
                                <Button
                                  type="button"
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="icon"
                                  aria-label={`Delete row ${startIndex + index + 1}`}
                                  className="size-7 text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                                  onClick={() => onDelete(item)}
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                        )}
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>

          {/* Empty state takes ALL remaining height under the header */}
          {!isLoading && rows.length === 0 && (
            <NoData title={emptyTitle} description={emptyDescription} />
          )}
        </div>

        {pagination && pagination.total > 0 && (
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-t border-border px-4 pb-3 pt-0">
            <p className="pt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Page {pagination.page} of {totalPages} &nbsp;·&nbsp;{" "}
              {pagination.total} total
            </p>
            <PaginationControls
              currentPage={pagination.page}
              lastPage={totalPages}
              onPageChange={pagination.onPageChange}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GenericTable;

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

import type { AuthModel } from "@/lib/models";

// Single place that knows how the session is stored in the browser.
// Used by the AuthProvider AND the axios interceptors (token refresh),
// so both always see the same data.
export const AUTH_STORAGE_KEY = "token";
export const AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT = "auth:changed";

export function readStoredAuth(): AuthModel | undefined {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as AuthModel) : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export function writeStoredAuth(next: AuthModel) {
  localStorage.setItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT));
}

export function clearStoredAuth() {
  localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT));
}

import axios, {
  AxiosError,
  type AxiosInstance,
  type InternalAxiosRequestConfig,
} from "axios";
import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";
import {
  clearStoredAuth,
  readStoredAuth,
  writeStoredAuth,
} from "./auth-storage";

const baseURL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000/api";

// Create Axios Instance
const axiosInstance: AxiosInstance = axios.create({
  baseURL,
  withCredentials: true,
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    Accept: "application/json",
    Pragma: "no-cache",
    "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-store",
  },
});

// ── Request: always send the latest access token ────────────────────────────
axiosInstance.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = readStoredAuth()?.token;
  if (token && !config.headers.has("Authorization")) {
    config.headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
  }
  return config;
});

// ── Response: on 401 try ONE silent refresh, then retry the request ─────────
type RetriableConfig = InternalAxiosRequestConfig & { _retry?: boolean };

// These endpoints must never trigger a refresh (would loop / is meaningless)
const NO_REFRESH_URLS: string[] = [
  UrlConstants.LOGIN_URL,
  UrlConstants.REFRESH_URL,
];

// If many requests fail at once, they all wait for the same refresh call
let refreshPromise: Promise<string> | null = null;

async function refreshAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
  const stored = readStoredAuth();
  if (!stored?.refreshToken) throw new Error("No refresh token");

  // Plain axios (not axiosInstance) so this call skips our interceptors
  const res = await axios.post<{ token: string; refreshToken?: string }>(
    `${baseURL}${UrlConstants.REFRESH_URL}`,
    { refreshToken: stored.refreshToken },
    { withCredentials: true },
  );

  writeStoredAuth({
    ...stored,
    token: res.data.token,
    refreshToken: res.data.refreshToken ?? stored.refreshToken,
  });
  return res.data.token;
}

axiosInstance.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const original = error.config as RetriableConfig | undefined;
    const url = original?.url ?? "";

    if (
      error.response?.status !== 401 ||
      !original ||
      original._retry ||
      NO_REFRESH_URLS.some((u) => url.includes(u))
    ) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    original._retry = true;

    try {
      refreshPromise ??= refreshAccessToken().finally(() => {
        refreshPromise = null;
      });
      const token = await refreshPromise;
      original.headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
      return axiosInstance(original);
    } catch {
      // Refresh failed -> session is over. AuthProvider listens and redirects.
      clearStoredAuth();
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
  },
);

export default axiosInstance;

/**
 * Bikram Sambat (BS) <-> Gregorian (AD) utilities.
 *
 * BS month lengths (29-32 days) are published by Nepal's calendar committee and
 * cannot be derived from a formula, so conversion is table driven.
 * Table covers BS 2001-2095 (AD 1944-04-13 .. 2039-04-13).
 *
 * Epoch: BS 2001-01-01 === AD 1944-04-13.
 *
 * Form value format used by <BsDatePicker />: BS string "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g. "2081-05-14"),
 * or "" when empty.
 */

export const BS_MIN_YEAR = 2001;
export const BS_MAX_YEAR = 2095;

export interface BsDate {
  year: number;
  /** 1-12 (1 = Baisakh) */

  day: number;
}

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
/** AD 1944-04-13 === BS 2001-01-01 */
const EPOCH_UTC = Date.UTC(1944, 3, 13);
const EPOCH_WEEKDAY = new Date(EPOCH_UTC).getUTCDay(); // 0 = Sunday

// Day offset (from epoch) at which each BS year starts, and total supported days.
const { YEAR_START, TOTAL_DAYS } = (() => {
  const map = new Map<number, number>();
  let acc = 0;
  for (let y = BS_MIN_YEAR; y <= BS_MAX_YEAR; y++) {
    map.set(y, acc);
    acc += BS_MONTH_DAYS[y].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  }
  return { YEAR_START: map, TOTAL_DAYS: acc };
})();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Core conversion
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function getDaysInBsMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
  const row = BS_MONTH_DAYS[year];
  if (!row || !Number.isInteger(month) || month < 1 || month > 12) {
    throw new RangeError(`Unsupported BS month ${year}-${month}`);
  }
  return row[month - 1];
}

export function isValidBsDate({ year, month, day }: BsDate): boolean {
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(year) ||
    !Number.isInteger(month) ||
    !Number.isInteger(day)
  )
    return false;
  if (year < BS_MIN_YEAR || year > BS_MAX_YEAR || month < 1 || month > 12)
    return false;
  return day >= 1 && day <= getDaysInBsMonth(year, month);
}

function bsToOffset({ year, month, day }: BsDate): number {
  const row = BS_MONTH_DAYS[year];
  let offset = YEAR_START.get(year)!;
  for (let m = 0; m < month - 1; m++) offset += row[m];
  return offset + (day - 1);
}

/** BS -> AD. Returns a local-midnight Date. Throws RangeError if the BS date is invalid. */
export function bsToAd(date: BsDate): Date {
  if (!isValidBsDate(date)) {
    throw new RangeError(`Invalid or unsupported BS date ${formatBs(date)}`);
  }
  const u = new Date(EPOCH_UTC + bsToOffset(date) * DAY_MS);
  return new Date(u.getUTCFullYear(), u.getUTCMonth(), u.getUTCDate());
}

/** AD -> BS (uses the Date's local year/month/day). Throws RangeError outside table range. */
export function adToBs(date: Date): BsDate {
  const offset = Math.round(
    (Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()) -
      EPOCH_UTC) /
      DAY_MS,
  );
  if (offset < 0 || offset >= TOTAL_DAYS) {
    throw new RangeError("Date is outside supported BS range (2001-2095)");
  }
  let year = BS_MAX_YEAR;
  while (YEAR_START.get(year)! > offset) year--;
  let rem = offset - YEAR_START.get(year)!;
  const row = BS_MONTH_DAYS[year];
  let m = 0;
  while (rem >= row[m]) {
    rem -= row[m];
    m++;
  }
  return { year, month: m + 1, day: rem + 1 };
}

/** Weekday of the 1st of a BS month. 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. */
export function getBsMonthStartWeekday(year: number, month: number): number {
  return (EPOCH_WEEKDAY + bsToOffset({ year, month, day: 1 })) % 7;
}

/** Today's BS date in Nepal time (Asia/Kathmandu), regardless of the browser's timezone. */
export function todayBs(): BsDate {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kathmandu",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const get = (t: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === t)!.value);
  return adToBs(new Date(get("year"), get("month") - 1, get("day")));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Parsing / formatting / comparing
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const BS_STRING_RE = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/;

/** "2081-05-14" -> BsDate, or null when empty/malformed/invalid. */
export function parseBs(value: string | null | undefined): BsDate | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  const m = BS_STRING_RE.exec(value.trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const date = { year: Number(m[1]), month: Number(m[2]), day: Number(m[3]) };
  return isValidBsDate(date) ? date : null;
}

/** Handy for zod `.refine()`. */
export function isBsDateString(value: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return parseBs(value) !== null;
}

/** BsDate -> "YYYY-MM-DD" */
export function formatBs({ year, month, day }: BsDate): string {
  return `${String(year).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export function compareBs(a: BsDate, b: BsDate): number {
  return a.year - b.year || a.month - b.month || a.day - b.day;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function getBsMonthName(month: number, lang: BsLang = "en"): string {
  return (lang === "ne" ? BS_MONTHS_NE : BS_MONTHS_EN)[month - 1];
}

const NE_DIGITS = ["०", "१", "२", "३", "४", "५", "६", "७", "८", "९"];

export function toNepaliDigits(value: string | number): string {
  return String(value).replace(/\d/g, (d) => NE_DIGITS[Number(d)]);
}

/** Digits in the requested language. */
export function localizeDigits(
  value: string | number,
  lang: BsLang = "en",
): string {
  return lang === "ne" ? toNepaliDigits(value) : String(value);
}

/** "14 Bhadra 2081" / "१४ भदौ २०८१" */
export function formatBsLong(date: BsDate, lang: BsLang = "en"): string {
  return `${localizeDigits(date.day, lang)} ${getBsMonthName(date.month, lang)} ${localizeDigits(date.year, lang)}`;
}

import type { T_UseQueryError } from "@/types/common";
import type { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { type Path, type UseFormSetError } from 'react-hook-form';
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";
import moment from 'moment';

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export const mapFieldsOnError = <T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  err: AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>,
  setError: UseFormSetError<T>,
  handleDeepErrors = false,
) => {
  if (err.response?.data.status !== 422) return;
  const data = err.response?.data.data;
  if (!data) return;

  Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    // Check if deep errors exist
    if (key === "_deepErrors") {
      if (!handleDeepErrors) return;
      const deepErrors = (value as any).issues as unknown as {
        code: string;
        message: string;
        path: string[];
      }[];

      // For each deep error, set the error on the form
      deepErrors.forEach((deepError) => {
        const path = deepError.path.join(".");
        setError(path as Path<T>, {
          type: "manual",
          message: deepError.message,
        });
      });
      return;
    }

    const error = value[0];
    setError(key as Path<T>, {
      type: "manual",
      message: error,
    });
  });
};
export const formatDate = (date: string | Date) => {
  return moment(date).format("YYYY-MM-DD");
};

export const getPaginationItems = (
  total: number,
  currentPage: number,
  delta: number = 2,
) => {
  const range: number[] = [];
  const pagination: (number | string)[] = [];
  let last: number = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
    if (
      i === 1 ||
      i === total ||
      (i >= currentPage - delta && i <= currentPage + delta)
    ) {
      range.push(i);
    }
  }

  for (const page of range) {
    if (last) {
      if (page - last === 2) {
        pagination.push(last + 1);
      } else if (page - last > 2) {
        pagination.push("...");
      }
    }
    pagination.push(page);
    last = page;
  }

  return pagination;
};

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";
import Badge from "@/components/ui/badge";
import GenericTable, { type T_TableHead } from "@/components/generic-table";
import Input from "@/components/ui/input";
import Button from "@/components/ui/button";
import QUERY_KEYS from "@/lib/query-keys";

const LIMIT = 50;

export default function AccountantAttendancePage() {
  const [empId, setEmpId] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState("2026-01-01");
  const [markFilter, setMarkFilter] = useState("");
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ACCOUNTANT_ATTENDANCE, empId, date],
    queryFn: () => ({ attUrl: "/accountant/attendance", employeeId: empId, date }),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_ATT[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  const markMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      await fetch(`/accountant/attendance`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("auth")}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ employeeId: empId, date, mark: markFilter || undefined }),
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ACCOUNTANT_ATTENDANCE] }),
  });

  const head: T_TableHead<T_ATT>[] = [
    { key: "employeeName", headName: "Employee", minWidth: 240 },
    { key: "designation", headName: "Designation", minWidth: 180 },
    { key: "date", headName: "Date", minWidth: 160 },
    { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 160, render: (a) => <Badge variant={mapStatus(a.mark)}>{a.mark}</Badge> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Employee Attendance"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Accountant", link: "/accountant" }, { title: "Employee Attendance", link: "/accountant/attendance" }]}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Select employee..." value={empId} onChange={(e) => { setEmpId(e.target.value); setMarkFilter(""); }} />
        <select className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-background" value={date} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}>
          {[...Array(30)].map((_, i) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i); const y = d.getFullYear(), m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"), day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); return <option key={i} value={`${y}-${m}-${day}`}>—{y}.{m}.{day}</option>; })}
        </select>
        <select className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-background" value={markFilter} onChange={(e) => setMarkFilter(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="PRESENT">Present</option>
          <option value="ABSENT">Absent</option>
          <option value="HALF DAY">Half Day</option>
          <option value="LEAVE">Leave</option>
        </select>
        <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!empId || markMut.isPending} onClick={async () => { await markMut.mutateAsync(); toast.success("Attendance saved"); }}>
          {markMut.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={rows}
        emptyTitle="No attendance records."
        pagination={{ page: 1, limit: LIMIT, total: rows.length, onPageChange: () => {} }}
        searchPlaceholder="Select employee and date..."
        renderRow={(r) => ({ employeeName: r.employeeName, designation: r.designation ?? "—", status: mapStatus(r.mark) } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function mapStatus(m: string): Badge["variant"] {
  if (m === "PRESENT") return "default";
  if (m === "ABSENT") return "destructive";
  if (m === "HALF DAY") return "warning";
  if (m === "LEAVE") return "secondary";
  return "outline";
}

type T_ATT = {
  employeeId: string;
  employeeName: string;
  designation?: string;
  date: string;
  mark: "PRESENT" | "ABSENT" | "HALF DAY" | "LEAVE";
};

import { useState } from "react";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { createFeeStructure } from "../service/service";

interface FeeStructureFormProps {
  mode: "create" | "assign";
  onClose: () => void;
  structureId?: string;
  initial?: { courseName: string; batchId?: string; termLabel: string };
}

export default function FeeStructureFormDialog({ mode, onClose, structureId, initial }: FeeStructureFormProps) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    courseName: initial?.courseName ?? "",
    batchId: initial?.batchId ?? "",
    termLabel: initial?.termLabel ?? "",
    feeHeadCode: "",
    amount: 0,
  });
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (mode === "create") {
        await createFeeStructure(form);
      } else if (structureId) {
        // assign fee structure to a student / batch
        await fetch(`/accountant/fee-structures/${structureId}/assign`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("auth")}` },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ...form, studentId: "", batchId: form.batchId || "" }),
        });
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["fee-structures"] }); toast.success("Saved"); onClose(); },
  });

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{mode === "create" ? "New Fee Structure" : "Assign Fee Structure"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Enter fee head and amount per semester or year.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Course Name *</label>
              <Input value={form.courseName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, courseName: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Batch ID</label>
              <Input value={form.batchId} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, batchId: e.target.value })} placeholder="Leave blank if no batch" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Term Label *</label>
            <Input value={form.termLabel} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, termLabel: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. First Semester" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Fee Head Code *</label>
            <Input value={form.feeHeadCode} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, feeHeadCode: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. TUREGA" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Amount ( NPR ) *</label>
            <Input type="number" value={form.amount} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, amount: Number(e.target.value) })} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!form.courseName || !form.feeHeadCode || form.amount <= 0 || mutation.isPending}
            onClick={async () => { await mutation.mutateAsync(); }}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { postJournalEntry, reverseJournalEntry } from "../service/service";
import type { T_JOURNAL_LINE } from "../service/service";

interface JournalEntryFormProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function JournalEntryForm({ onClose }: JournalEntryFormProps) {
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<T_JOURNAL_LINE[]>([
    { id: "1", accountCode: "1001", description: "", amount: 0, direction: "DEBIT" },
    { id: "2", accountCode: "2001", description: "", amount: 0, direction: "CREDIT" },
  ]);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Live totals — must balance on submit
  const debitTotal = lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "DEBIT").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amount, 0);
  const creditTotal = lines.filter((l) => l.direction === "CREDIT").reduce((s, l) => s + l.amount, 0);

  // Block submit unless equal
  if (debitTotal !== creditTotal) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await postJournalEntry({ lines });
      toast.success("Journal entry posted");
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Post Journal Entry</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Live debit &amp; credit totals must balance before submitting.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {/* Total summary — block submit if not equal */}
          <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm font-semibold">
            <span className="text-destructive">Debit : ₹{debitTotal}</span>
            <span className="text-foreground">Credit : ₹{creditTotal}</span>
            <span className={debitTotal === creditTotal ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-red-500"}>Balance : ₹{debitTotal - creditTotal}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Group account selection — cannot select group accounts */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label>Accounts (group accounts disabled)</Label>
            <select multiple value="" onChange={() => {}} className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm">
              <option value="1001">Student Ledger</option>
              <option value="2001">Employee Ledger</option>
              <option value="3001">Account Ledger</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Lines editor */}
          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-60 overflow-auto">
            {lines.map((line, i) => (
              <div key={line.id} className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 items-center">
                <Input placeholder="Account Code" value={line.accountCode} disabled className="col-span-1" />
                <Input placeholder="Description" value={line.description} onChange={(e) => setLines((v) => v.map((x, j) => j === i ? { ...x, description: e.target.value } : x))} className="col-span-2" />
                <Input type="number" placeholder="Amount" value={line.amount} disabled className="col-span-1" />
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => setLines((v) => v.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>✕</Button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!debitTotal || creditTotal || submitting} onClick={handleSubmit}>
              {submitting ? "Posting..." : "Post"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";

export type T_JOURNAL_LINE = {
  id: string;
  accountCode: string;
  description: string;
  amount: number;
  direction: "DEBIT" | "CREDIT";
};

export type T_JOURNAL_ENTRY = {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  lines: T_JOURNAL_LINE[];
  debitTotal: number;
  creditTotal: number;
  balance?: number;
  groupAccount?: boolean;
  dateBs?: string;
  posted: boolean;
  reversed: boolean;
  details?: string;
  createdAt?: string;
};

export async function listJournalEntries(params: { page: number; limit: number }) {
  const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.ACCOUNTANT_JOURNAL_URL}`, { params });
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function postJournalEntry(input: { lines: T_JOURNAL_LINE[]; dateBs?: string }): Promise<{ message: string; posted?: boolean; balance?: number; warning?: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.ACCOUNTANT_JOURNAL_URL}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

// Reverse a mistake — only ever called on an already-posted entry, never edited or deleted
export async function reverseJournalEntry(entryId: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.ACCOUNTANT_JOURNAL_URL}/${entryId}/reverse`);
  return res.data as never;
}

        renderRow={(j) => ({ description: j.description, debitTotal: j.debitTotal, creditTotal: j.creditTotal, balance: j.balance ?? "0", groupAccount: j.groupAccount ?? "" } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />

      {closedFYId && (
        <ConfirmDeleteDialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setClosedFYId(null)} itemId={closedFYId} itemName="Fiscal Year" onDelete={async () => { void isClosed({ fiscalYearId: closedFYId! }); setClosedFYId(null); }} />
      )}

      {createOpen && <JournalEntryForm onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

type T_JOURNAL_ENTRY = {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  debitTotal: number;
  creditTotal: number;
  balance?: number;
  groupAccount?: boolean; // true if a group account — cannot post to these
  dateBs?: string;
};
