import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { addPayment, cancelReceipt } from "../service/service";

interface SplitPaymentDialogProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  paymentId?: string; // for cancel dialog instead of create
  receiptId?: string;
}

export default function SplitPaymentDialog({ onClose, paymentId, receiptId }: SplitPaymentDialogProps) {
  const isCancel = !!paymentId || !!receiptId;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (receiptId) {
      await cancelReceipt(receiptId!, "Wrong receipt — cancelled");
      toast.success("Receipt cancelled & reversed");
      onClose();
    } else if (paymentId) {
      toast.info("Payment edit (append-only cancel only)");
      onClose();
    } else {
      toast.success("Payment recorded");
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{isCancel ? "Cancel Receipt" : "Record Payment"} · {paymentId ? "Edit Payment" : "New Payment"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {isCancel
              ? "Wrong receipt — cancel creates a reversal entry. Never edit or delete."
              : "Enter the total and split across payment methods (must equal the total)."}{" "}
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">Status is append-only after creation.</span>
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {!isCancel && (
            <>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Total Amount ( NPR ) *</label>
                <Input type="number" value="" placeholder="Enter total amount" className="w-40" disabled={!!paymentId} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Method Lines (split) *</label>
                {/* Split list */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">Method Code</label>
                    <select className="w-full rounded border px-2 py-1 text-sm" defaultValue="">
                      <option value="">Select</option>
                      <option value="CASH">Cash</option>
                      <option value="BANK">Bank Transfer</option>
                      <option value="ONLINE">Online</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">Amount *</label>
                    <Input type="number" className="w-full" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">Ref No.</label>
                    <Input className="w-full" placeholder="Reference number" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          {isCancel && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Reason (required for cancellation) *</label>
              <textarea value="" placeholder="Explain why this receipt is being cancelled..." className="w-full rounded border px-3 py-2 text-sm" required />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" disabled={!isCancel || !paymentId}
            onClick={async () => { await handleSubmit(); }}>
            {isCancel ? "Reverse Receipt" : "Save Payment"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

const LIMIT = 20;

export default function AccountantPayslipsPage() {

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [payrollId, setPayrollId] = useState("");
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({

  });

  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Payslips"

      />

        <span className="self-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Mark approved payrolls as paid — creates the payroll journal entry.</span>
      </div>

        tableHeads={head}

        pagination={{ page, limit: LIMIT, total: 0, onPageChange: setPage }}

      />

export default function AccountantReceiptsPage() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [cancelId, setCancelId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  // Receipt list — READ is required for all roles
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ACCOUNTANT_RECEIPTS, search, page],
    queryFn: () => ({ receiptsUrl: "/accountant/receipts" }),
  });

  const rows: T_RECEIPT[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  const cancelMut = useMutation({

  });

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Payments & Receipts"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Accountant", link: "/accountant" }, { title: "Payments & Receipts", link: "/accountant/receipts" }]}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Search receipts..." onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} />
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={[
          { key: "receiptNo", headName: "Receipt No.", minWidth: 200 },
          { key: "studentName", headName: "Student", minWidth: 200 },
          { key: "totalAmount", headName: "Total ( NPR )", minWidth: 160 },
          { key: "createdAt", headName: "Created At", minWidth: 180 },
          { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 120, render: (r) => <Badge variant={r.status === "CANCELLED" ? "destructive" : "default"}>{r.status}</Badge> },
        ]}
        data={rows}
        emptyTitle="No receipts found."
        pagination={{ page, limit: LIMIT, total: 0, onPageChange: setPage }}
        searchPlaceholder="Search receipts..."
      />

      {cancelId && (
        <ConfirmDeleteDialog
          open
          onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setCancelId(null)}
          itemId={cancelId}
          itemName="Receipt"
          onDelete={async (id) => { await cancelReceipt(id!, "Cancelled by user"); toast.success("Reversal entry created"); setCancelId(null); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { createBatch, updateBatch } from "../service/service";
import type { T_BATCH } from "../service/service";

interface BatchFormProps {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  onClose: () => void;
  initial?: T_BATCH;
  batchId?: string;
}

export default function BatchFormDialog({ mode, onClose, initial, batchId }: BatchFormProps) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: initial?.name ?? "", currentTermNumber: initial?.currentTermNumber ?? 1, isActive: true });
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (mode === "create") return createBatch(form);
      if (batchId) return updateBatch(batchId, form);
    },
    onSuccess: () => { toast.success("Saved"); onClose(); },
    onError: () => {},
  });

  const handleSubmit = () => mutation.mutate();

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{mode === "create" ? "Create Batch" : "Update Batch"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Enter batch details.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Name *</label>
            <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Current Term Number *</label>
            <Input type="number" value={form.currentTermNumber} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, currentTermNumber: Number(e.target.value) })} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Is Active</label>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, isActive: !form.isActive })}
              className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs ${form.isActive ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "bg-secondary"}`}>
              {form.isActive ? "Yes" : "No"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!form.name || mutation.isPending} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

      {tab === "batches" && <BatchesView />}
      {tab === "terms" && <TermsView />}
      {tab === "subjects" && <SubjectsView />}
    </div>
  );
}

function BatchesView() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const deleteId = useState<string | null>(null);

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ADMIN_BATCH_LIST, search, page],
    queryFn: () => listBatches({ page, limit: 10, search }),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_BATCH[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total = query.data?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / 10));

  const moveMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ batchId, nextTermNumber }: { batchId: string; nextTermNumber: number }) =>
      moveBatchToNextTerm(batchId, nextTermNumber),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ADMIN_BATCH_LIST] }); },
  });

  const head: T_TableHead<T_BATCH>[] = [
    { key: "id", headName: "ID", minWidth: 120 },
    { key: "name", headName: "Name", minWidth: 220 },
    { key: "currentTermNumber", headName: "Current Term", minWidth: 160, render: (b) => `#${b.currentTermNumber}` },
    { key: "isActive", headName: "Status", minWidth: 100, render: (b) => <Badge variant={b.isActive ? "default" : "destructive"}>{b.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}</Badge> },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-4 flex justify-end">
        <Button onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>New Batch</Button>
      </div>
      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={rows}
        onEdit={(b) => `/admin/batches?mode=edit&id=${b.id}`}
        onDelete={(b) => { /* delete TODO */ }}
        onSearch={setSearch}
        emptyTitle="No batches."
        pagination={{ page, limit: 10, total, onPageChange: setPage }}
        searchPlaceholder="Search batches..."
      />
      {createOpen && <BatchFormDialog mode="create" onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)} />}
      {editId && <BatchFormDialog mode="edit" batchId={editId} onClose={() => setEditId(null)} initial={rows.find((r) => r.id === editId)!} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function TermsView() {

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ADMIN_TERM_LIST, batchId],

function SubjectsView() {

export type T_EMPLOYEE_ROLE = "PRINCIPAL" | "ACCOUNTANT" | "TEACHER" | "STAFF";

export type T_EMPLOYEE = {
  id: string;
  employeeCode: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName?: string;
  middleName?: string | null;
  email: string;
  passwordHash?: string | null;
  role: T_EMPLOYEE_ROLE;
  designation: string;
  phone?: string | null;
  gender: "MALE" | "FEMALE" | "OTHERS";
  ssfNo?: string | null;
  bankAccountNo?: string | null;
  panNo?: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt?: string;
};

export async function listEmployees(params: { page: number; limit: number; search?: string }) {
  const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_URL}`, { params });
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function createEmployee(input: {
  firstName: string;
  lastName?: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  role: T_EMPLOYEE_ROLE;
  designation?: string;
  gender?: "MALE" | "FEMALE" | "OTHERS";
  phone?: string;
}): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_URL}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function updateEmployee(id: string, input: Partial<{
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  role: T_EMPLOYEE_ROLE;
  designation: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}>): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.put(`${UrlConstants.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_URL}/${id}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function deleteEmployee(id: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.delete(`${UrlConstants.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_URL}/${id}`);
  return res.data as never;
}

// --- Shared form dialog ---
function EmployeeFormDialog({ mode, employeeId, onClose }: { mode: "create" | "edit"; employeeId?: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    firstName: "",
    lastName: "",
    email: "",
    password: "",
    role: "TEACHER",
    designation: "Staff",
    gender: "MALE",
    phone: "",
  });

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (mode === "create") {
        return createEmployee(form as never);
      } else if (employeeId) {
        return updateEmployee(employeeId, form as never);
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      useAuth2().logout();
    },
    onError: () => {},
    onSettled: () => {},
  });

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    await mutation.mutateAsync();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
      <div className="max-w-lg w-full rounded-lg border p-6 space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{mode === "create" ? "Create Employee" : "Update Employee"}</h3>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">First Name *</label>
          <Input value={form.firstName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, firstName: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Last Name *</label>
          <Input value={form.lastName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, lastName: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Email *</label>
          <Input value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Password *</label>
          <Input type="password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Role</label>
            <select
              className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm"
              value={form.role}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, role: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="PRINCIPAL">Principal</option>
              <option value="ACCOUNTANT">Accountant</option>
              <option value="TEACHER">Teacher</option>
              <option value="STAFF">Staff</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Designation</label>
            <Input value={form.designation} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, designation: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Phone</label>
          <Input value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Gender</label>
          <select
            className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm"
            value={form.gender}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, gender: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="MALE">Male</option>
            <option value="FEMALE">Female</option>
            <option value="OTHERS">Others</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={submitting || !form.firstName || !form.lastName || !form.email}
            onClick={handleSubmit}>
            {submitting ? "Saving..." : mode === "create" ? "Create" : "Save"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface FiscalYearFormProps {

  onClose: () => void;

export default function FiscalYearFormDialog({ mode, onClose, initial, id }: FiscalYearFormProps) {

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Start Date (BS)</label>

          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">End Date (BS)</label>
            <Input value={form.endDateBs} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, endDateBs: e.target.value })} placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" />

        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!form.year || mutation.isPending}
            onClick={async () => { await mutation.mutateAsync(); }}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";

export type T_FY_STATUS = "OPEN" | "CLOSED";
const FY_URL = UrlConstants.ADMIN_FISCALYEAR_URL;

export type T_FY = {
  id: string;
  year: string;
  startDateBs?: string;
  endDateBs?: string;
  status: T_FY_STATUS;
  createdAt?: string;
};

export async function listFiscalYears(params: { page: number; limit: number; search?: string }) {
  const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${FY_URL}`, { params });
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function createFiscalYear(input: { year: string; startDateBs?: string; endDateBs?: string }): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.post(`${FY_URL}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function updateFiscalYear(id: string, input: Partial<{ year: string; startDateBs: string; endDateBs: string }>): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.put(`${FY_URL}/${id}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function deleteFiscalYear(id: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.delete(`${FY_URL}/${id}`);
  return res.data as never;
}

// Helper: closed fiscal years block payments/journal entries at the API.
export async function isClosed(params: { fiscalYearId: string }): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${FY_URL}/${params.fiscalYearId}/closed`);
    return (res.data as { closed: boolean }).closed;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

    queryFn: () => listFiscalYears({ page, limit: LIMIT, search }),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_FY[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total = query.data?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / LIMIT));

  const head: T_TableHead<T_FY>[] = [
    { key: "year", headName: "Year", minWidth: 100 },
    { key: "startDateBs", headName: "Start Date", minWidth: 180 },
    { key: "endDateBs", headName: "End Date", minWidth: 180 },

      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">

      {deleteId && <ConfirmDeleteDialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)} itemId={deleteId} itemName="Fiscal Year" onDelete={deleteFiscalYear} />}

import { useState } from "react";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { createNotice } from "../service/service";

interface NoticeDialogProps {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  onClose: () => void;
  noticeId?: string;
  initial?: { title: string; content: string };
}

export default function NewNoticeDialog({ mode, onClose, noticeId, initial }: NoticeDialogProps) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ title: initial?.title ?? "", content: initial?.content ?? "" });
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (mode === "create") return createNotice(form);
      // edit path — backend endpoint PUT /api/notices/:id
      return await fetch(`/api${`notices/${noticeId}`}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ title: form.title, content: form.content }),
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["notices"] }); toast.success("Saved"); onClose(); },
  });

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{mode === "create" ? "New Notice" : "Edit Notice"}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Draft or publish a system notice.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Title *</label>
            <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Content *</label>
            <textarea value={form.content} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, content: e.target.value })} rows={8}
              placeholder="Enter notice content..." className="w-full rounded border px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!form.title || !form.content || mutation.isPending}
            onClick={async () => { await mutation.mutateAsync(); }}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

      ]} submitText="Create" service={async (vals) => ({ message: "" })} />}

function SimpleFormDialog({ fields, mode, onClose, submitText, service }: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  onClose: () => void;
  submitText?: string;
  fields: { key: string; label: string; type?: "number" | "text"; required?: boolean; placeholder?: string }[];
  service: (vals: Record<string, string>) => Promise<{ message?: string }>;
}) {
  return <SubjectFormDialog mode={mode} onClose={onClose} submitText={submitText ?? "Save"} fields={fields} service={service} />;
}

function SubjectFormDialog({ mode, onClose, submitText, fields, service }: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  onClose: () => void;
  submitText: string;
  fields: { key: string; label: string; type?: "number" | "text"; required?: boolean; placeholder?: string }[];
  service: (vals: Record<string, string>) => Promise<{ message?: string }>;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => { await service(values); },
    onSuccess: () => { useAuth2().logout(); },
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-lg border p-6 space-y-3">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{mode === "create" ? "Create Subject" : "Update Subject"}</h3>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {fields.map((f) => (
            <div key={f.key} className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{f.label}{f.required && <span className="text-destructive"> *</span>}</label>
              <input type={f.type ?? "text"} value={values[f.key] ?? ""} placeholder={f.placeholder ?? ""}
                className="w-full rounded border px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                required={f.required}
                onChange={(e) => setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [f.key]: e.target.value }))} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={mutation.isPending} onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : submitText}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/context/auth-context";
function useAuth2(): typeof useAuth { return useAuth(); }

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ studentId: "", studentName: "", courseCode: "", subjectId: "", termNumber: 1 });
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => createTeachingAssignment(form),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ADMIN_TEACHING_ASSIGNMENT_LIST] }); toast.success("Assignment created"); setCreateOpen(false); },
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Teaching Assignments"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Admin", link: "/admin" }, { title: "Teaching Assignments", link: "/admin/teaching-assignments" }]}
        createPage="/admin/teaching-assignments?mode=create"
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Search assignments..." onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} />
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>New Assignment</Button>
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={rows}
        onSearch={setSearch}
        emptyTitle="No teaching assignments found."
        pagination={{ page, limit: LIMIT, total, onPageChange: setPage }}
        searchPlaceholder="Search assignments..."
      />

      {createOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">

                <Input value={form.studentId} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, studentId: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Student Name *</label>
                <Input value={form.studentName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, studentName: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Course Code *</label>
                <Input value={form.courseCode} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, courseCode: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. COMP101" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Subject ID *</label>
                <Input value={form.subjectId} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subjectId: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Term Number *</label>
                <Input type="number" value={form.termNumber} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, termNumber: Number(e.target.value) })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!form.studentId || !form.subjectId || !form.termNumber || mutation.isPending}
                onClick={async () => { await mutation.mutateAsync(); }}>
                {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Create"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// --- Simple form dialog helper ---
function SimpleFormDialog({ fields, mode, onClose, submitText, service, id, initial }: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  onClose: () => void;
  submitText?: string;
  fields: { key: string; label: string; type?: "number" | "text"; required?: boolean; placeholder?: string }[];
  service: (vals: Record<string, string>) => Promise<{ message?: string }>;
  id?: string;
  initial?: { [k: string]: unknown };
}) {
  return <TermFormDialog mode={mode} id={id} initial={initial} fields={fields} onClose={onClose} submitText={submitText ?? "Save"} service={service} />;
}

function TermFormDialog({ mode, id, initial, fields, onClose, submitText, service }: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  id?: string;
  initial?: { [k: string]: unknown };
  fields: { key: string; label: string; type?: "number" | "text"; required?: boolean; placeholder?: string }[];
  onClose: () => void;
  submitText: string;
  service: (vals: Record<string, string>) => Promise<{ message?: string }>;
}) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (id) { const r = await service(values); r.message ?? ""; }
      else { await service(values); }
    },
    onSuccess: () => { useAuth2().logout(); },
  });

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-lg border p-6 space-y-3">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{mode === "create" ? "Create Term" : "Update Term"}</h3>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {fields.map((f) => (
            <div key={f.key} className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{f.label}{f.required && <span className="text-destructive"> *</span>}</label>
              <input type={f.type ?? "text"} value={values[f.key] ?? ""} placeholder={f.placeholder ?? ""}
                className="w-full rounded border px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                required={f.required}
                onChange={(e) => setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [f.key]: e.target.value }))} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={mutation.isPending} onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}>
            {mutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : submitText}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useAuth } from "@/auth/context/auth-context";
function useAuth2(): typeof useAuth { return useAuth(); }

import { useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/context/auth-context";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Form, FormControl, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormMessage } from "@/components/form";
import type { Role } from "../shared/role-login-schema";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { roleLoginSchema } from "../shared/role-login-schema";

const ROLE_TITLE: Record<Role, string> = {
  ADMIN: "Admin",
  PRINCIPAL: "Principal",
  ACCOUNTANT: "Accountant",
  TEACHER: "Teacher",
  STAFF: "Staff",
};

type TRoleLoginFormValues = z.infer<typeof roleLoginSchema>;

function LoginForm({ role }: { role: Role }) {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const form = useForm<TRoleLoginFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(roleLoginSchema),
    defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
    mode: "onBlur",
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: TRoleLoginFormValues) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(values.email, values.password);
      window.location.href = "/dashboard";
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-6 text-center">{ROLE_TITLE[role]} Login</h1>
      <div className="card-shadow card p-6 space-y-4">
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="email"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Email Address</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input placeholder="accountant@example.com" type="email" autoComplete="email" {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="password"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Password</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>

import * as z from "zod";

// 1. Define your Zod validation schema
export const registerSchema = z
  .object({
    username: z.string().min(2, "Username must be at least 2 characters"),
    email: z.email("Invalid email address"),
    password: z.string().min(6, "Password must be at least 6 characters"),
    confirmPassword: z.string(),
  })
  .refine((data) => data.password !== data.confirmPassword, {
    message: "Passwords don't match",
    path: ["confirmPassword"],
  });
export type T_RegisterSchema = z.infer<typeof registerSchema>;

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import { useNavigate, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { Role } from "./role-login-schema";
import type { TRoleLoginSchema } from "./role-login-schema";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { roleLoginSchema } from "./role-login-schema";
import { Card, CardHeader, CardDescription, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";

interface RoleLoginFormProps {
  role: Role;
  nextPath?: string;
}

// Single reusable card driven by the shared backend login endpoint, used by all five per-role pages.
// Each page passes in its title text (the backend already routes by role, so this is just presentation).
export function RoleLoginForm({ role, nextPath = "/dashboard" }: RoleLoginFormProps) {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  void navigate;

  const form = useForm<TRoleLoginSchema>({
    resolver: zodResolver(roleLoginSchema),
    defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
    mode: "onBlur",
  });

  async function onSubmit(values: TRoleLoginSchema) {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(values.email, values.password);
      navigate(nextPath);
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <ScreenLoader />
      <Card className="h-auto p-8 w-full" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{ROLE_TITLE[role]} Login</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Enter your <strong>{ROLE_TITLE[role]} </strong>email below to login
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="email"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Email Address</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="johndoe@example.com" type="email" autoComplete="email" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="password"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Password</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="*******" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 place-items-center gap-2 mt-3">
              <Button type="submit" className="w-9/10">
                Login
              </Button>

              <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="w-9/10">
                <Link to={role === "ADMIN" ? "/auth/admin/register" : "/register"}>
                  {role === "ADMIN" ? "Register" : "Other"}
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { z } from "zod";

// Mirrors backend enum Role in schema.prisma: ADMIN | PRINCIPAL | ACCOUNTANT | TEACHER | STAFF
// STUDENT is preseeded, not a login surface.
export type Role = "ADMIN" | "PRINCIPAL" | "ACCOUNTANT" | "TEACHER" | "STAFF";

// Shared login shape — login page is always email + password; the role is chosen at login
// by which route the user came from, never validated per-field by Zod. Keeps frontend
// schemas one file from backend login validation.
export const roleLoginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.email({ message: "Email is required" }),
  password: z
    .string({ message: "Password is required" })
    .min(6, "Password must be at least 6 characters"),
});

export type TRoleLoginSchema = z.infer<typeof roleLoginSchema>;

import { z } from "zod";
import NepaliDate from "nepali-date-converter";

export const BatchSchema = z.object({
  courseId: z.string().min(1, "Course ID is required"),
  name: z.string().min(1, "Batch name is required"),
  startDate: z.date().optional(),
  currentTermNumber: z.number().int().min(1, "Term must be at least 1"),
  isActive: z.boolean(),
});

export type T_BatchSchema = z.infer<typeof BatchSchema>;

export const BatchDefaultValues: T_BatchSchema = {
  courseId: "",
  name: "",
  startDate: undefined,
  currentTermNumber: 1,
  isActive: true,
};

// What the API receives
export type T_BatchPayload = Omit<T_BatchSchema, "startDate"> & {
  startDateBs?: string;
};

// Date (AD) -> "YYYY-MM-DD" (BS)
export const toBatchPayload = ({
  startDate,
  ...rest
}: T_BatchSchema): T_BatchPayload => ({
  ...rest,
  startDateBs: startDate
    ? new NepaliDate(startDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")
    : undefined,
});

// "YYYY-MM-DD" (BS) -> Date (AD)
export const bsToDate = (bs?: string | null): Date | undefined =>
  bs ? new NepaliDate(bs).toJsDate() : undefined;

import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";
import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import type {
  T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination,
  T_AxiosResponseWithPagination,
} from "@/types/common";
import type { T_BatchSchema } from "../schema/schema";

export type T_Batch = {
  id: string;
  courseId: string;
  name: string;
  startDateBs?: string | null;
  currentTermNumber: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};

export const getAllBatches = async (args: {
  page?: number;
  search?: string;
  limit?: number;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithPagination<T_Batch> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.BATCH_URL}`, {
      params: {
        page: args.page,
        limit: args.limit,
        search: args.search || "",
      },
    });
  return response.data;
};

export const removeBatch = async (id: string) => {
  const response = await axiosInstance.delete(
    `${UrlConstants.BATCH_URL}/${id}`,
  );
  return response.data;
};

export const createBatch = async (data: T_BatchSchema) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Batch> =
    await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.BATCH_URL}`, {
      courseId: data.courseId,
      name: data.name,
      startDateBs: data.startDateBs || undefined,
      currentTermNumber: data.currentTermNumber,
      isActive: data.isActive,
    });
  return response.data;
};

export const getBatchById = async (id: string) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Batch> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.BATCH_URL}/${id}`);
  return response.data;
};

export const updateBatch = async (args: {
  data: T_BatchSchema;
  id: string;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Batch> =
    await axiosInstance.patch(`${UrlConstants.BATCH_URL}/${args.id}`, {
      courseId: args.data.courseId,
      name: args.data.name,
      startDateBs: args.data.startDateBs || undefined,
      currentTermNumber: args.data.currentTermNumber,
      isActive: args.data.isActive,
    });
  return response.data;
};

import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useNavigate, useParams, Link } from "react-router";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { mapFieldsOnError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { QUERY_KEYS } from "@/lib/query-keys";
import type { T_UseQueryError } from "@/types/common";
import { BatchSchema, type T_BatchSchema } from "./schema/schema";
import { getBatchById, updateBatch } from "./service/service";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";

  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader,

  const form = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(BatchSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      courseId: "",
      name: "",
      currentTermNumber: 1,
      isActive: true,
    },
  });

    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.BATCH, id],
    queryFn: () => getBatchById(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });

    if (data?.data) {
      const batch = data.data;
      form.reset({
        courseId: batch.courseId,
        name: batch.name,
        startDateBs: batch.startDateBs || "",
        currentTermNumber: batch.currentTermNumber,
        isActive: batch.isActive,
      });
    }

    mutationFn: (formData: T_BatchSchema) =>
      updateBatch({ data: formData, id: id! }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Batch updated successfully.");
      navigate("/batch");
    },
    onError: (error: AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>) => {
      mapFieldsOnError(error, form.setError);
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || "Failed to update batch.");
    },
  });

    updateMutation.mutate(values);
  };

  if (isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        <AlertHandler
          variant="error"
          title="Error"
          message="Failed to fetch batch details."
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
      <PageHeader
        title="Edit Batch"
        description="Update batch information and status."
        backPage="/batch"
        backPageTitle="Back to Batches"
        breadCrumbItems={[
          { title: "Batches", link: "/batch" },
          { title: "Edit" },
        ]}
      />

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Batch Information</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Modify the details below.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Form {...form}>
            <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="name"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Batch Name</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="e.g. 2081 Fall" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="courseId"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Course ID (UUID)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        placeholder="e.g. c1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
                        {...field}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="startDateBs"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel isOptional>Start Date (BS)</FormLabel>

                        checked={field.value}
                        onCheckedChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <div className="space-y-1 leading-none">
                      <FormLabel>Active Status</FormLabel>
                      <FormDescription>
                        Enable this batch for active operations.
                      </FormDescription>
                    </div>
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-4">
                <Link to="/batch">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={updateMutation.isPending}
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                </Link>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  loading={updateMutation.isPending}
                  disabled={updateMutation.isPending}
                >
                  Save Changes
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import z from "zod";

export const billingItemSchema = z
  .object({
    discountType: z.enum(["Percentage", "Fixed"]),
    discount: z.coerce.number(),
  })
  .refine(
    (data) => {
      if (data.discountType === "Percentage") {
        return data.discount >= 0 && data.discount <= 100;
      }
      // Fixed
      return data.discount >= 0;
    },
    {
      message:
        "Discount must be between 0 and 100 for Percentage, or non-negative for Fixed",
      // Optionally point to the field that caused the error:
      path: ["discount"],
    },
  );

export type T_BillingItemSchema = {
  discountType: "Percentage" | "Fixed";
  discount: number;
};

import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import type { T_CreateBillingData } from "../types/types";
import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";

export const createBilling = async (data: T_CreateBillingData) => {
  // Check if discount is NaN, null, or undefined, and fall back to 0
  const safeDiscount = isNaN(data.discount) ? 0 : data.discount;

  const response = await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.BILLING_URL}`, {
    ...data,
    discount: safeDiscount, // Overwrites the discount with 0 if it was NaN
  });

  return response.data;
};

import type { T_BillingItem, T_ShowBillingItem } from "../types/types";

export const isItemInCart = (
  showCart: T_ShowBillingItem[],
  actualCart: T_BillingItem[],
  productId: string,
): boolean => {
  return showCart.some((item) => item.productId === productId) &&
         actualCart.some((item) => item.productId === productId);
};

import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";
import { QUERY_KEYS } from "@/lib/query-keys";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  getAllCategories,
  type T_Categories,
} from "../categories/service/service";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import {
  getAllProducts,
  productsByCategory,
  type T_Products,
  type T_ProductsByCategory,
} from "../product/service/service";
import { useState } from "react";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";
import { useDebounce } from "use-debounce";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/form";

import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";

import type { AxiosError } from "axios";

import { createBilling } from "./service/service";
import { toast } from "sonner";

  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { isItemInCart } from "./utils/billing-functions";
import { EditIcon, Info, Minus, PackageX, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import { UpdateCartDialog } from "@/components/dialog/cartUpdate-dialog";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  BillReceiptDialog,
  type T_BillData,
} from "@/components/dialog/bill-receipt-dialog";

export default function BillingPage() {
  const [currentSelectedCategory, setCurrentSelectedCategory] =
    useState<string>("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch] = useDebounce(search, 500);
  const [visibleBillingItems, setVisibleBillingItems] = useState<
    T_ShowBillingItem[]
  >([]);
  const [billingItems, setBillingItems] = useState<T_BillingItem[]>([]);
  const [openCartUpdateDialog, setOpenCartUpdateDialog] =
    useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<{
    productId: string;
    displayName: string;
    currentQuantity: number;
    quantityLimit: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const [billReceiptOpen, setBillReceiptOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createdBill, setCreatedBill] = useState<T_BillData | null>(null);
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const form = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(billingItemSchema),
    defaultValues: { discountType: "Percentage", discount: 0 },
  });

  const createBillingMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: createBilling,
    onSuccess: (res) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT_LIST],
      });
      setCreatedBill(res.data);
      setBillReceiptOpen(true);
      setBillingItems([]);
      setVisibleBillingItems([]);

      form.reset();
    },
    onError: (error: AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>) => {
      const errors = error.response?.data?.data;

      if (errors && !Array.isArray(errors) && errors["quantity"]) {
        toast.error(errors["quantity"][0]);
        return;
      }
      mapFieldsOnError(error, form.setError);
    },
  });

  const handleSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearch(e.target.value);
  };

  const { data: result, isLoading: isCategoryFetchLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.CATEGORY_LIST],
    queryFn: () => getAllCategories({ page: 1, search: "", limit: 100 }),
  });

  const Categories: T_Categories[] = result?.data?.data ?? [];

  if (!currentSelectedCategory && Categories.length > 0) {
    setCurrentSelectedCategory(Categories[0].id);
  }

  // Query To Fetch Products by Category
  const getProductByCategoryQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT_LIST, currentSelectedCategory],
    queryFn: () => productsByCategory(currentSelectedCategory),
    enabled: !!currentSelectedCategory,
  });

  const Products: T_ProductsByCategory[] = getProductByCategoryQuery.data ?? [];

  // Query to Search Products By name
  const getProductBySearchQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT_LIST, debouncedSearch],
    queryFn: () =>
      getAllProducts({ search: debouncedSearch, page: 1, limit: 100 }),
    enabled: !!debouncedSearch,
  });

  const SearchedProducts: T_Products[] =
    getProductBySearchQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  const removeProductFromBilling = (productId: string) => {
    setBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems.filter((item) => item.productId !== productId),
    );
    setVisibleBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems.filter((item) => item.productId !== productId),
    );
  };
  const increseProductToBilling = (productId: string, quantity: number = 1) => {
    setBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems
        .map((item) =>
          item.productId === productId
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + quantity }
            : item,
        )
        .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0),
    );
    setVisibleBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems
        .map((item) =>
          item.productId === productId
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + quantity }
            : item,
        )
        .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0),
    );
  };
  const decreaseProductToBilling = (productId: string) => {
    setBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems
        .map((item) =>
          item.productId === productId
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity - 1 }
            : item,
        )
        .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0),
    );
    setVisibleBillingItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems
        .map((item) =>
          item.productId === productId
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity - 1 }
            : item,
        )
        .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0),
    );
  };
  const handleAddProductToBilling = (
    product: T_Products | T_ProductsByCategory,
  ) => {
    const { id, name, price, quantity } = product;
    const existingItem: boolean = isItemInCart(
      visibleBillingItems,
      billingItems,
      id,
    );
    if (existingItem) {
      const cartItem = visibleBillingItems.find((i) => i.productId === id);
      if (cartItem && cartItem.quantity >= quantity) {
        toast.error(
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">Stock Limit Reached</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Only{" "}
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                {cartItem.stockQuantity}
              </span>{" "}
              units available in stock.
            </span>
          </div>,
          {
            icon: (
              <PackageX className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            ),
          },
        );
        return;
      }
      setBillingItems((prevItems) =>
        prevItems.map((item) =>
          item.productId === id
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 }
            : item,
        ),
      );
      setVisibleBillingItems((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) =>
          item.productId === id
            ? { ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 }
            : item,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      setBillingItems((prevItems) => [
        ...prevItems,
        {
          productId: id,
          quantity: 1,
        },
      ]);
      setVisibleBillingItems((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          productId: id,
          productName: name,
          price: price,
          quantity: 1,
          total: price,
          stockQuantity: quantity,
        },
      ]);
    }
  };
  const grandTotal = visibleBillingItems.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
    0,
  );
  if (isCategoryFetchLoading || getProductByCategoryQuery.isLoading) {
    return <ScreenLoader />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-3 flex gap-3 h-screen no-scrollbar">
      <Card className="w-1/2 h-[90%] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="pl-2">
          <Input
            className="w-72"
            placeholder="Search products by name or category...."
            value={search}
            onChange={handleSearch}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Category Tabs */}
        <ScrollArea className="w-full whitespace-nowrap pb-1 border-b">
          <div className="flex gap-2 px-2 py-1">
            {Categories.map((category, i) => (
              <button
                key={i}
                disabled={!!debouncedSearch}
                onClick={() => setCurrentSelectedCategory(category.id)}
                className={`
                  shrink-0 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium
                  transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer
                  disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
                  ${
                    currentSelectedCategory === category.id && !debouncedSearch
                      ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm"
                      : "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80"
                  }
                `}
              >
                {category.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" />
        </ScrollArea>

        {/* Products Grid */}
        <ScrollArea className="flex-1">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {debouncedSearch ? (
              <>
                {getProductBySearchQuery.isLoading && (
                  <div className="col-span-3 flex justify-center p-4">
                    <ScreenLoader />
                  </div>
                )}
                {getProductBySearchQuery.isError && (
                  <AlertHandler
                    className="col-span-3"
                    variant="error"
                    title="Error Occured"
                    message="Something went wrong while searching products."
                  />
                )}
                {!getProductBySearchQuery.isLoading &&
                  SearchedProducts.length === 0 && (
                    <AlertHandler
                      className="w-70! m-1"
                      variant="error"
                      title="No Products Found"
                      message="No products match your search."
                    />
                  )}
                {SearchedProducts.map((product, index) => (
                  <Card
                    key={index}
                    className={`relative m-1.5 transition-all duration-150 ${
                      product.quantity <= 0
                        ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
                        : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/70 hover:shadow-md"
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (product.quantity <= 0) {
                        toast.error("This item is currently out of stock");
                        return; // ✅ early return — add hँदैन
                      }
                      handleAddProductToBilling(product);
                    }}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-1">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-sm truncate">
                          {product.name}
                        </span>
                        <Popover>
                          <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              aria-label={`View details for ${product.name}`}
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                              className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Info className="h-4 w-4" />

                          </PopoverContent>

                      </div>

                          Rs. {product.price}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                          Qty: {product.quantity}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {getProductByCategoryQuery.isError &&
                  !getProductByCategoryQuery.isLoading && (

                      className="col-span-3"

                      title="Error Occured"
                      message="Something went wrong while fetching products. Please try again."
                    />
                  )}
                {Products.length === 0 && (
                  <AlertHandler
                    className="col-span-3 m-1"
                    variant="error"
                    title="No Products Found"
                    message="This category doesn't have any products yet."
                  />
                )}
                {Products.map((product, index) => (

                      product.quantity <= 0
                        ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
                        : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/70 hover:shadow-md"
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (product.quantity <= 0) {
                        toast.error("This item is currently out of stock");
                        return;
                      }
                      handleAddProductToBilling(product);
                    }}

                    <CardContent className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-1">

                ))}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>
      </Card>
      <Card className="w-1/2 h-[90%] overflow-hidden">
        <Form {...form}>
          <form
            onSubmit={form.handleSubmit((data) => {
              if (billingItems.length === 0) {
                toast.error(
                  "Please add at least one product to the billing list!",
                );
                return;
              }
              createBillingMutation.mutate({
                ...data,
                products: billingItems,
              });

              <ScrollArea className="overflow-y-auto overflow-x-auto h-55 rounded-md border">
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 bg-muted/50 z-10">
                    <TableRow className="hover:bg-muted/50">
                      <TableHead className="w-10 text-center">SN</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Product</TableHead>

                      <TableHead className="w-16 text-center">
                        Quantity
                      </TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                      <TableHead> </TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {visibleBillingItems.length === 0 ? (
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableCell colSpan={5} className="p-0!">
                          <div className="w-full h-full"></div>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ) : (
                      visibleBillingItems.map((item, index) => (
                        <TableRow key={index}>
                          <TableCell>{index + 1}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{item.productName}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-center">
                            {item.price}
                          </TableCell>

                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">

                                type="button"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-6 w-6"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  decreaseProductToBilling(item.productId);
                                }}
                              >
                                <Minus className="h-3 w-3" />
                              </Button>
                              <span className="w-6 text-center text-sm tabular-nums">
                                {item.quantity}
                              </span>
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-6 w-6"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  increseProductToBilling(item.productId);
                                }}
                              >
                                <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <span className="flex justify-center items-center">
                              Rs. {item.quantity * item.price}
                            </span>
                          </TableCell>

                          <TableCell>
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                              {" "}
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-6 w-6"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  setEditingItem({
                                    productId: item.productId,
                                    displayName: item.productName,
                                    currentQuantity: item.quantity,
                                    quantityLimit: item.stockQuantity ?? 0,
                                  });
                                  setOpenCartUpdateDialog(true);
                                }}
                              >
                                <EditIcon className="h-3 w-3" />
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                type="button"
                                variant={"ghost"}
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  removeProductFromBilling(item.productId);
                                }}
                              >
                                <X />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </ScrollArea>
              <Table>
                <TableBody>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell className="font-semibold">Grand Total</TableCell>
                    <TableCell colSpan={3} />
                    <TableCell className="text-right font-bold">
                      Rs. {grandTotal}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="discountType"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Discount Type</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <SelectCommand
                        options={[
                          { label: "Percentage", value: "Percentage" },
                          { label: "Flat", value: "Fixed" },
                        ]}
                        value={field.value}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="discount"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Discount</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        placeholder="Eg: 5% or Rs.100"
                        value={field.value as number}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                        onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end items-center mr-2 gap-2">
              <Link to={"/dashboard"}>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={createBillingMutation.isPending}
                  variant={"secondary"}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </Link>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                loading={createBillingMutation.isPending}
                disabled={createBillingMutation.isPending}
              >
                Create
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </Card>
      <UpdateCartDialog
        key={editingItem?.productId}
        open={openCartUpdateDialog}
        onOpenChange={setOpenCartUpdateDialog}
        productId={editingItem?.productId}
        itemDisplayName={editingItem?.displayName}
        itemQuantityLimit={editingItem?.quantityLimit}
        currentQuantity={editingItem?.currentQuantity}
        setVisibleCart={setVisibleBillingItems}
        setActualCart={setBillingItems}
      />
      <BillReceiptDialog
        open={billReceiptOpen}
        onOpenChange={setBillReceiptOpen}
        bill={createdBill}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// components/category/schema/category-schema.ts
import { z } from "zod";

export const CategorySchema = z.object({
  name: z
    .string({ message: "Name is required" })
    .min(1, "Name is required")
    .max(100, "Name must be at most 100 characters"),
  shortName: z
    .string({ message: "Short name is required" })
    .min(1, "Short name is required")
    .max(3, "Short name must be at most 3 characters"),
});

export type T_CategorySchema = z.infer<typeof CategorySchema>;

export const CategorySchemaDefaultValues: T_CategorySchema = {
  name: "",
  shortName: "",
};

import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";
import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import type {
  T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination,
  T_AxiosResponseWithPagination,
} from "@/types/common";
import type { T_CategorySchema } from "../schema/schema";

export type T_Categories = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};
export const getAllCategories = async (args: {
  page?: number;
  search?: string;
  limit?: number;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithPagination<T_Categories> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}`, {
      params: {
        page: args.page,
        limit: args.limit,
        search: args.search || "",
      },
    });
  return response.data;
};

export const removeCategory = async (id: string) => {
  const response = await axiosInstance.delete(
    `${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}/${id}`,
  );
  return response.data;
};

export const createCategory = async (data: T_CategorySchema) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Categories> =
    await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}`, {
      name: data.name,
      shortName: data.shortName,
    });
  return response.data;
};

export const getProductsByCategoryId = async (id: string) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithPagination<T_Categories> =
    await axiosInstance.get(
      `${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}/${id}`,
    );
  return response.data;
};

export const getCategoryById = async (id: string) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Categories> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}/${id}`);
  return response.data;
};

export const updateCategory = async (args: {
  data: T_CategorySchema;
  id: string;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_Categories> =
    await axiosInstance.patch(`${UrlConstants.CATEGORY_URL}/${args.id}`, {
      name: args.data.name,
      shortName: args.data.shortName,
    });
  return response.data;
};

// components/category/update-category.tsx
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { mapFieldsOnError } from "@/lib/utils";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/form";
import { CategorySchema, type T_CategorySchema } from "./schema/schema";
import { getCategoryById, updateCategory } from "./service/service";
import type { T_UseQueryError } from "@/types/common";

const UpdateCategory = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const form = useForm<T_CategorySchema>({
    resolver: zodResolver(CategorySchema),
    defaultValues: { name: "", shortName: "" },
  });

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["category", id],
    queryFn: () => getCategoryById(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (query.data?.data) {
      form.reset({
        name: query.data.data.name,
        shortName: query.data.data.shortName,
      });
    }
  }, [query.data, query.isSuccess, form]);

  const updateCategoryMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: updateCategory,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Category updated successfully.");
      return navigate("/category");
    },
    onError: (error: AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>) => {
      mapFieldsOnError(error, form.setError);
      return toast.error(error.response?.data.message);
    },
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <title>Update Category | Billing System</title>
      <PageHeader
        title="Update Category"
        breadCrumbItems={[
          { title: "Home", link: "/" },
          { title: "Categories", link: "/category" },
          { title: "Update", link: `/category/${id}` },
        ]}
      />

      <Form {...form}>
        <form
          onSubmit={form.handleSubmit((data) => {
            updateCategoryMutation.mutate({ data, id: id! });
          })}
        >
          <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 sm:gap-x-3 gap-y-3">
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="name"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="Eg: Electronics, Groceries"
                      disabled={query.isLoading}
                      {...field}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />

            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="shortName"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Short Name</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="Eg: ELC, GRO"
                      disabled={query.isLoading}
                      {...field}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end items-center space-x-3 mb-5 mt-5">
            <Link to={"/category"}>
              <Button
                type="button"
                disabled={updateCategoryMutation.isPending}
                variant={"secondary"}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              loading={updateCategoryMutation.isPending}
              disabled={updateCategoryMutation.isPending || query.isLoading}
            >
              Update
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Form>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UpdateCategory;

  removeCategory,
