} from "./service/service";
import { QUERY_KEYS } from "@/lib/query-keys";
import ConfirmDeleteDialog from "@/components/dialog/delete-dialog";

const LIMIT = 10;

const Categories = () => {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [isDeleteDialogOpen, setIsDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedItemId, setselectedItemId] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch] = useDebounce(search, 500);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    data: result,
    isLoading,
    isError,
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.CATEGORY_LIST, debouncedSearch, page],
    queryFn: () =>
      getAllCategories({ page, limit: LIMIT, search: debouncedSearch }),
  });

  const rows: T_Categories[] = result?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total: number = result?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / LIMIT));

  // Reset to page 1 when search changes
  const handleSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearch(e.target.value);
    setPage(1);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Categories"
        breadCrumbItems={[
          { title: "Home", link: "/" },
          { title: "Categories", link: "/category" },
        ]}
        createPage="/category/create"
      />
      <div className="px-8">
        {" "}
        {/* wrap content separately */}
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="mb-4">
          <Input
            className="w-72"
            placeholder="Search categories..."
            value={search}
            onChange={handleSearch}
          />
        </div>
        {isLoading && <ScreenLoader />}
        {isError && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-10 text-destructive">
            Failed to load categories.
          </div>
        )}
        {!isLoading && !isError && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto border rounded-md">
              <Table className="w-full table-auto">
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow className="bg-muted hover:bg-muted">
                    <TableHead className="w-16 border-r">SN</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Short Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Created At</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Updated At</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right border-r">
                      Actions
                    </TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>

                <TableBody>
                  {rows.length === 0 ? (
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8"
                      >
                        No categories found.
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ) : (
                    rows.map((item, idx) => (
                      <TableRow
                        key={item.id}
                        className="divide-x divide-border"
                      >
                        <TableCell>{(page - 1) * LIMIT + idx + 1}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.name ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.shortName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {item.createdAt?.split("T")[0] ?? "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {item.updatedAt?.split("T")[0] ?? "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right space-x-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            aria-label="Edit"
                            onClick={() => navigate(`/category/${item.id}`)}
                          >
                            <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            aria-label="Delete"
                            className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setselectedItemId(item.id);
                              setIsDeleteDialogOpen(true);
                            }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))
                  )}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>

            {totalPages > 1 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Page {page} of {totalPages} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {total} total
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="icon"
                    disabled={page === 1}
                    onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="icon"
                    disabled={page === totalPages}
                    onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                  >
                    <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <ConfirmDeleteDialog
        open={isDeleteDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsDeleteDialogOpen}
        itemId={selectedItemId ?? ""}
        onDelete={removeCategory}
        itemName="Category"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Categories;

export default function PrincipalAttendancePage() {
  const [selectedEmpId, setSelectedEmpId] = useState("");
  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState("2026-01-01"); // default today (BS)
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const empQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_LIST], queryFn: () => listEmployees({ page: 1, limit: 200 }) });

  const attQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_ATTENDANCE, selectedEmpId, currentDate],
    queryFn: () => ({ principalAttendanceUrl: "/principal/attendance", employeeId: selectedEmpId, date: currentDate }),
  });

  if (attQuery.isLoading || empQuery.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (attQuery.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  // Fetch employees list for the dropdown
  const employees: T_EMPLOYEE[] = empQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  return (

      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Select employee..." value={selectedEmpId} onChange={(e) => setSelectedEmpId(e.target.value)} />
        <select
          className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-background"
          value={currentDate}
          onChange={(e) => setCurrentDate(e.target.value)}
        >
          {[...Array(30)].map((_, i) => {
            const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
            const y = d.getFullYear(), m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"), day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
            return <option key={i} value={`${y}-${m}-${day}`}>—{y}.{m}.{day}</option>;
          })}
        </select>
        <select className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-background" value={statusFilter} onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
          <option value="PRESENT">Present</option>
          <option value="ABSENT">Absent</option>
          <option value="LEAVE">Leave</option>
          <option value="HALF DAY">Half Day</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={[
          { key: "employeeName", headName: "Employee", minWidth: 240 },
          { key: "designation", headName: "Designation", minWidth: 180 },
          { key: "date", headName: "Date", minWidth: 180 },
          { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 160, render: (r: any) => <Badge variant={mapStatus(r.status)}>{r.status}</Badge> },
        ]}
        data={[]}
        emptyTitle="No attendance records."
        pagination={{ page: 1, limit: LIMIT, total: 0, onPageChange: () => {} }}
        searchPlaceholder="Select employee and date..."
        renderRow={() => ({ employeeName: "", designation: "", status: "" } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function mapStatus(s: string): Badge["variant"] {
  if (s === "PRESENT") return "default";
  if (s === "ABSENT") return "destructive";
  if (s === "HALF DAY") return "warning";
  if (s === "LEAVE") return "secondary";
  return "outline";
}

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";
import Badge from "@/components/ui/badge";
import GenericTable, { type T_TableHead } from "@/components/generic-table";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import QUERY_KEYS from "@/lib/query-keys";
import Input from "@/components/ui/input";
import Button from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { T_PENDING_PAYROLL } from "./service/service";

const LIMIT = 20;

export default function PrincipalPendingPayrollPage() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_PAYROLL_PENDING, page],
    queryFn: () => fetch("/principal/payroll/pending").then((r) => r.json()),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_PENDING_PAYROLL[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total = query.data?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / LIMIT));

  const approveMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ payrollId }) => approvePayroll(payrollId),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_PAYROLL_PENDING] }); toast.success("Payroll approved"); },
  });

  const rejectMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ payrollId, reason }) => rejectPayroll(payrollId, reason),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_PAYROLL_PENDING] }); toast.success("Payroll rejected"); },
  });

  const head: T_TableHead<T_PENDING_PAYROLL>[] = [
    { key: "employeeName", headName: "Employee", minWidth: 200 },
    { key: "month", headName: "Month", minWidth: 160 },
    { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 180, render: (p) => <Badge variant={p.status === "APPROVED" ? "success" : "warning"}>{p.status}</Badge> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Pending Payroll"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Principal", link: "/principal" }, { title: "Pending Payroll", link: "/principal/payroll/pending" }]}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Search payroll..." onChange={() => {}} />
        <span className="self-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Monthly payroll submitted by Accountant.</span>
      </div>
      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={rows}
        onSearch={() => {}}
        emptyTitle="No pending payroll."
        pagination={{ page, limit: LIMIT, total, onPageChange: setPage }}
        searchPlaceholder="Search payroll..."
        renderRow={(p) => ({ employeeName: p.employeeName, status: p.status }) as Record<string, ReactNode>}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

type T_PENDING_PAYROLL = {
  id?: string;
  employeeName: string;
  month: string;
  status: "DRAFT" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED" | "PAID";
  remarks?: string | null;
};

async function approvePayroll(id: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await fetch(`/principal/payroll/${id}/approve`);
  return res.json();
}

async function rejectPayroll(id: string, reason: string): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await fetch(`/principal/payroll/${id}/reject`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
  });
  return res.json();
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";
import Badge from "@/components/ui/badge";
import GenericTable, { type T_TableHead } from "@/components/generic-table";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import QUERY_KEYS from "@/lib/query-keys";

const LIMIT = 20;

export default function PrincipalPendingResultsPage() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_RESULTS_PENDING, page],
    queryFn: () => fetch("/principal/results/pending").then((r) => r.json()),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_PENDING_RESULT[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total = query.data?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / LIMIT));

  const approveMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ resultId }) => approveResult(resultId),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_RESULTS_PENDING] }); toast.success("Result approved"); },
  });

  const rejectMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ resultId, reason }) => rejectResult(resultId, reason),
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRINCIPAL_RESULTS_PENDING] }); toast.success("Result rejected"); },
  });

  const head: T_TableHead<T_PENDING_RESULT>[] = [
    { key: "examName", headName: "Exam", minWidth: 220 },
    { key: "batchName", headName: "Batch", minWidth: 180 },
    { key: "studentName", headName: "Student", minWidth: 220 },
    { key: "subjectName", headName: "Subject", minWidth: 180 },
    { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 160, render: (r) => <Badge variant={r.status === "APPROVED" ? "success" : "warning"}>{r.status}</Badge> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Pending Results"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Principal", link: "/principal" }, { title: "Pending Results", link: "/principal/results/pending" }]}
      />
      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={rows}
        pagination={{ page, limit: LIMIT, total, onPageChange: setPage }}
        emptyTitle="No pending results."
        renderRow={(r) => ({ examName: r.examName, batchName: r.batchName, studentName: r.studentName, subjectName: r.subjectName, status: r.status } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

type T_PENDING_RESULT = {
  id: string;
  examName: string;
  batchName: string;
  studentName: string;
  subjectName: string;
  status: "PENDING";
};

async function approveResult(id: string) {
  await fetch(`/principal/results/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
}
async function rejectResult(id: string, reason: string) {
  await fetch(`/principal/results/${id}/reject`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("auth")}` } });
}

// schema/schema.ts
import { z } from "zod";

export const ProductSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, "Name is required").max(100),
  shortName: z.string().min(1, "Short name is required").max(3),
  price: z.coerce
    .number({ message: "Price is required" })
    .min(0, "Price must be positive"),
  quantity: z.coerce
    .number({ message: "Quantity is required" })
    .min(0, "Quantity must be positive"),
  categoryId: z.string().min(1, "Category is required"),
});

export type T_ProductSchema = z.infer<typeof ProductSchema>;

import type {
  T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination,
  T_AxiosResponseWithPagination,
} from "@/types/common";
import type { T_ProductSchema } from "../schema/schema";
import axiosInstance from "@/lib/axios-request";
import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";
import type { T_Categories } from "@/pages/categories/service/service";

export type T_Products = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  categoryId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};
export type T_ProductsByCategory = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  categoryId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  category: T_Categories;
};

export const getAllProducts = async (args: {
  page?: number;
  search?: string;
  limit?: number;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithPagination<T_Products> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}`, {
      params: {
        page: args.page,
        limit: args.limit,
        search: args.search || "",
      },
    });
  return response.data;
};
// service/service.ts
export const createProduct = async (data: T_ProductSchema) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_ProductSchema> =
    await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}`, data);
  return response.data;
};

export const getProductById = async (id: string) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_ProductSchema> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}/${id}`);
  return response.data;
};

export const updateProduct = async (args: {
  id: string;
  data: T_ProductSchema;
}) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_ProductSchema> =
    await axiosInstance.patch(
      `${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}/${args.id}`,
      args.data,
    );
  return response.data;
};

export const removeProduct = async (id: string) => {
  const response = await axiosInstance.delete(
    `${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}/${id}`,
  );
  return response.data;
};

export const productsByCategory = async (id: string) => {
  const response: T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T_ProductsByCategory[]> =
    await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.PRODUCT_URL}/category/${id}`, {
      params: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 100,
        search: "",
      },
    });
  return response.data.data;
};

// components/product/edit-product.tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { type T_UseQueryError } from "@/types/common";
import { QUERY_KEYS } from "@/lib/query-keys";
import { mapFieldsOnError } from "@/lib/utils";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";

import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/form";
import { getAllCategories } from "../categories/service/service";
import { getProductById, updateProduct } from "./service/service";
import { ProductSchema } from "./schema/schema";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import SelectCommand from "@/components/common/select-command";

const EditProduct = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const form = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(ProductSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: "",
      shortName: "",
      categoryId: "",
      price: 0,
      quantity: 0,
    },
  });
  const categoriesQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.CATEGORY_LIST],
    queryFn: () => getAllCategories({ limit: 100 }),
  });

  const categories = categoriesQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const productQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT, id],
    queryFn: () => getProductById(id ?? ""),
    enabled: !!id && categoriesQuery.isSuccess,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (productQuery.isSuccess && productQuery.data) {
      const p = productQuery.data.data;
      form.reset({
        name: p.name,
        shortName: p.shortName,
        price: p.price,
        quantity: p.quantity,
        categoryId: p.categoryId,
      });
    }
  }, [productQuery.data, productQuery.isSuccess, form]);

  const updateProductMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: updateProduct,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Product updated successfully.");
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT_LIST] });
      return navigate("/product");
    },
    onError: (error: AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>) => {
      mapFieldsOnError(error, form.setError);
      return toast.error(error.response?.data.message);
    },
  });

  if (productQuery.isLoading || categoriesQuery.isLoading)
    return <ScreenLoader />;

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <title>Edit Product | Billing System</title>
      <PageHeader
        title="Edit Product"
        breadCrumbItems={[
          { title: "Home", link: "/" },
          { title: "Products", link: "/product" },
          { title: "Edit", link: `/product/${id}` },
        ]}
      />

      <div className="px-8">
        <Form {...form}>
          <form
            onSubmit={form.handleSubmit((data) => {
              updateProductMutation.mutate({ id: id ?? "", data });
            })}
          >
            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 grid-rows-1 sm:gap-x-3 gap-y-3">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="name"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Name</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="Eg: Current Noodles" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="shortName"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Short Name</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="Eg: CRN" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="price"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Price</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        placeholder="Eg: 35"
                        value={field.value as number}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="quantity"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Quantity</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        placeholder="Eg: 150"
                        value={field.value as number}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="categoryId"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Category</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <SelectCommand
                        value={field.value}
                        onChange={field.onChange}
                        options={categories.map((cat) => ({
                          label: cat.name,
                          value: cat.id,
                        }))}
                        loading={categoriesQuery.isLoading}
                        placeholder="Select a category"
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end items-center space-x-3 mb-5 mt-5">
              <Link to="/product">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="secondary"
                  disabled={updateProductMutation.isPending}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </Link>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                loading={updateProductMutation.isPending}
                disabled={
                  updateProductMutation.isPending || categoriesQuery.isLoading
                }
              >
                Update
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default EditProduct;

// components/product/products.tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useDebounce } from "use-debounce";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { Pencil, Trash2, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import Button  from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import ConfirmDeleteDialog from "@/components/dialog/delete-dialog";
import { QUERY_KEYS } from "@/lib/query-keys";

import {
  getAllProducts,
  removeProduct,
  type T_Products,
} from "./service/service";

const LIMIT = 10;

const Products = () => {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [isDeleteDialogOpen, setIsDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedItemId, setSelectedItemId] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch] = useDebounce(search, 500);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    data: result,
    isLoading,
    isError,
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.PRODUCT_LIST, debouncedSearch, page],
    queryFn: () =>
      getAllProducts({ page, limit: LIMIT, search: debouncedSearch }),
  });

  const rows: T_Products[] = result?.data?.data ?? [];
  const total: number = result?.data?.pagination?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / LIMIT));

  const handleSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSearch(e.target.value);
    setPage(1);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Products"
        breadCrumbItems={[
          { title: "Home", link: "/" },
          { title: "Products", link: "/product" },
        ]}
        createPage="/product/create"
      />

      <div className="px-8">
        <div className="mb-4">
          <Input
            className="w-72"
            placeholder="Search products..."
            value={search}
            onChange={handleSearch}
          />
        </div>

        {isLoading && <ScreenLoader />}

        {isError && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-10 text-destructive">
            Failed to load products.
          </div>
        )}

        {!isLoading && !isError && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto border rounded-md">
              <Table className="w-full table-auto">
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow className="bg-muted hover:bg-muted">
                    <TableHead className="w-16 border-r  ">SN</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Short Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Price</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Quantity</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Created At</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="border-r">Updated At</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right border-r">
                      Actions
                    </TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>

                <TableBody>
                  {rows.length === 0 ? (
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableCell
                        colSpan={8}
                        className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8"
                      >
                        No products found.
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ) : (
                    rows.map((item, idx) => (
                      <TableRow
                        key={item.id}
                        className="divide-x divide-border"
                      >
                        <TableCell>{(page - 1) * LIMIT + idx + 1}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.name ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.shortName ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.price ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{item.quantity ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {item.createdAt?.split("T")[0] ?? "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {item.updatedAt?.split("T")[0] ?? "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right space-x-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            aria-label="Edit"
                            onClick={() => navigate(`/product/${item.id}`)}
                          >
                            <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            aria-label="Delete"
                            className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setSelectedItemId(item.id);
                              setIsDeleteDialogOpen(true);
                            }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))
                  )}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>

            {totalPages > 1 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Page {page} of {totalPages} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {total} total
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="icon"
                    disabled={page === 1}
                    onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="icon"
                    disabled={page === totalPages}
                    onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                  >
                    <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ConfirmDeleteDialog
        open={isDeleteDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsDeleteDialogOpen}
        itemId={selectedItemId}
        onDelete={removeProduct}
        itemName="Product"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Products;

export default function StaffAttendancePage() {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.STAFF_ATTENDANCE, search],
    queryFn: () => ({ attendanceUrl: "/staff/attendance" }),
  });

  if (query.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (query.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const rows: T_ATTMARK[] = query.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader title="My Attendance" breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Staff", link: "/staff" }, { title: "My Attendance", link: "/staff/attendance" }]} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Filter by date..." onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        {rows.map((r, i) => (
          <div key={r.id ?? i} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{r.studentName ?? r.employeeName}</span>
            <Badge variant={mapStatus(r.mark)}>{r.mark}</Badge>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function mapStatus(m: string): Badge["variant"] {
  if (m === "PRESENT") return "default";
  if (m === "ABSENT") return "destructive";
  if (m === "LEAVE") return "secondary";
  if (m === "HALF DAY") return "warning";
  return "outline";
}

import { useState } from "react";
type T_ATTMARK = { id?: string; studentName?: string; employeeName?: string; mark: string; date?: string };
void useState;

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";

import GenericTable, { type T_TableHead } from "@/components/generic-table";
import Button from "@/components/ui/button";
import Input from "@/components/ui/input";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import QUERY_KEYS from "@/lib/query-keys";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

const LIMIT = 20;

export default function TeacherMarksEntryPage() {
  const [selectedExamId, setSelectedExamId] = useState("");
  const [examName, setExamName] = useState("");
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  // Candidate list for selected exam
  const candidatesQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_MY_CLASSES],
    queryFn: () => ({ classesUrl: "/teacher/my-classes" }),
  });

  // Marks grid (one column per subject)
  const marksQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_MARKS, selectedExamId],
    queryFn: () => ({ marksUrl: "/teacher/marks" }),
  });

  if (candidatesQuery.isLoading || marksQuery.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (marksQuery.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const candidates: T_STUDENT_CANDIDATE[] = candidatesQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const subjects: T_SUBJECT[] = []; // fetched separately
  const examNameLabel = examName || "Select an exam";

  const mut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      await fetch(`/teacher/marks`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("auth")}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ examId: selectedExamId }),
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_MARKS] }); toast.success("Marks submitted — awaiting Principal approval"); },
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader title="Marks Entry" breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Teacher", link: "/teacher" }, { title: "Marks Entry", link: "/teacher/marks" }]} createPage="/teacher/marks?mode=new" />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Select exam..." value={selectedExamId} onChange={(e) => { setSelectedExamId(e.target.value); setExamName(e.target.value); }} />
        <span className="self-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Save as draft, then click Generate Result.</span>
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={[
          { key: "studentName", headName: "Student", minWidth: 200 },
          { key: "rollNo", headName: "Roll No.", minWidth: 120 },
          ...subjects.map((s) => ({ key: s.code, headName: `M${String(Number(s.code).slice(-2))}`, minWidth: 120 })),
          { key: "absentCheck", headName: "Absent", minWidth: 120, render: (r: any) => r.absentChecked ? <Badge variant="destructive">YES</Badge> : "" },
        ]}
        data={[]}
        emptyTitle="No students for this exam."
        renderRow={() => ({ studentName: "", rollNo: "" } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />

      {selectedExamId && (
        <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!selectedExamId || !examName || mut.isPending}
          onClick={async () => { await mut.mutateAsync(); }}>
          {mut.isPending ? "Generating..." : "Generate Result"}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type T_STUDENT_CANDIDATE = { id: string; studentName: string; rollNo: number };
type T_SUBJECT = { code: string; name: string };

import { UrlConstants } from "@/constants/endpoints";

export type T_STUDENT_STATUS = "ACTIVE" | "GRADUATED" | "DROPPED" | "SUSPENDED";
export type T_STUDENT_APPROVAL = "PENDING" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";

export type Guardian = {
  id?: string;
  relation: "FATHER" | "MOTHER" | "GUARDIAN" | "OTHER";
  fullName: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  occupation?: string;
  address?: string;

export type T_STUDENT = {
  id: string;
  universityRegNo: string;
  firstName: string;
  middleName?: string | null;

  gender: "MALE" | "FEMALE" | "OTHERS";

  temporaryAddress?: string | null;

export async function listStudentsForTeacher(params: { page: number; limit: number; search?: string }) {
  const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.TEACHER_STUDENTS_URL}`, { params });
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function createStudent(input: {
  firstName: string; lastName: string; universityRegNo: string; gender: "MALE" | "FEMALE" | "OTHERS";
  dobBs?: string; batchId?: string; phone?: string; email?: string; permanentAddress?: string; temporaryAddress?: string;
  guardian: { relation: Guardian["relation"]; fullName: string; phone?: string; email?: string; occupation?: string; address?: string };
}): Promise<{ message: string; id: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.post(`${UrlConstants.TEACHER_STUDENTS_URL}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function updateStudent(id: string, input: Partial<T_STUDENT>): Promise<{ message: string }> {
  const res = await axiosInstance.put(`${UrlConstants.ADMIN_STUDENT_URL}/${id}`, input);
  return res.data as never;
}

export async function listApprovedStudents(params: { page: number; limit: number; search?: string }) {
  const res = await axiosInstance.get(`${UrlConstants.TEACHER_STUDENTS_URL}/approved`, { params });
  return res.data as never;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import PageHeader from "@/components/common/page-header";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import AlertHandler from "@/components/common/alert-handler";
import Badge from "@/components/ui/badge";
import GenericTable, { type T_TableHead } from "@/components/generic-table";
import Button from "@/components/ui/button";
import Input from "@/components/ui/input";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import QUERY_KEYS from "@/lib/query-keys";

const LIMIT = 100;

export default function TeacherTakeAttendancePage() {
  const [selectedClassId, setSelectedClassId] = useState("");
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState("2026-01-01");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(""); // "" means everything else is marked present by default
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const classQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_MY_CLASSES],
    queryFn: () => ({ classesUrl: "/teacher/my-classes" }),
  });

  // attendance for selected class+date — default present for everyone else
  const attQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_ATTENDANCE, selectedClassId, selectedDate],
    queryFn: () => ({ attUrl: "/teacher/attendance" }),
  });

  if (classQuery.isLoading || attQuery.isLoading) return <ScreenLoader />;
  if (attQuery.isError) return <AlertHandler variant="error" />;

  const classes: T_CLASS[] = classQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];
  const attendees: T_STUDENT_ATTMARK[] = attQuery.data?.data?.data ?? [];

  const takeAttMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      await fetch(`/teacher/attendance`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("auth")}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ classId: selectedClassId, date: selectedDate, marks: statusFilter ? { allPresent: false } : undefined }),
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.TEACHER_ATTENDANCE] }); toast.success("Attendance saved"); },
  });

  const markAllPresent = async () => {
    await takeAttMut.mutateAsync();
    toast.success("All students marked present");
  };

  const head: T_TableHead<T_STUDENT_ATTMARK>[] = [
    { key: "studentName", headName: "Student", minWidth: 200 },
    { key: "status", headName: "Status", minWidth: 160, render: (a) => <Badge variant={mapStatus(a.mark)}>{a.mark}</Badge> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-5">
      <PageHeader
        title="Take Attendance"
        breadCrumbItems={[{ title: "Teacher", link: "/teacher" }, { title: "Take Attendance", link: "/teacher/take-attendance" }]}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 w-full max-w-4xl mb-4">
        <Input placeholder="Select class..." value={selectedClassId} onChange={(e) => setSelectedClassId(e.target.value)} />
        <select className="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-background" value={selectedDate} onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Date</option>
          {[...Array(30)].map((_, i) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i); const y = d.getFullYear(), m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"), day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); return <option key={i} value={`${y}-${m}-${day}`}>—{y}.{m}.{day}</option>; })}
        </select>
        <Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!selectedClassId || !selectedDate || takeAttMut.isPending} onClick={markAllPresent}>
          {takeAttMut.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Mark all present"}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <GenericTable
        tableHeads={head}
        data={attendees}
        emptyTitle="No students for this class & date."
        pagination={{ page: 1, limit: LIMIT, total: attendees.length, onPageChange: () => {} }}
        searchPlaceholder="Select class..."
        renderRow={(a) => ({ studentName: a.studentName, status: mapStatus(a.mark) } as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function mapStatus(m: string): Badge["variant"] {
  if (m === "PRESENT") return "default";
  if (m === "ABSENT") return "destructive";
  if (m === "LEAVE") return "secondary";
  if (m === "HALF DAY") return "warning";
  return "outline";
}

type T_CLASS = { id: string; batchName: string; subjectCode: string; className: string; studentCount: number };
type T_STUDENT_ATTMARK = { studentId: string; studentName: string; mark: "PRESENT" | "ABSENT" | "LEAVE" | "HALF DAY" };

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AuthContext } from "@/auth/context/auth-context";
import type { AuthModel, UserModel } from "@/lib/models";
import {
  readStoredAuth,
  writeStoredAuth,
  clearStoredAuth,
  AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT,
} from "@/lib/auth-storage";

import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import { getCurrentUser, loginUser, logoutUser, registerUser } from "@/auth/service/service";

interface AuthProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: AuthProviderProps) {
  const [auth, setAuth] = useState<AuthModel | undefined>(() =>
    readStoredAuth(),
  );
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserModel | undefined>(
    () => readStoredAuth()?.user,
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Sync auth state across tabs and local storage updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorageChange = () => {
      const stored = readStoredAuth();
      setAuth(stored);
      setUser(stored?.user);
    };

    window.addEventListener(AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT, handleStorageChange);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(AUTH_CHANGED_EVENT, handleStorageChange);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Rehydrate session on app load
  useEffect(() => {
    const initAuth = async () => {
      const stored = readStoredAuth();
      if (stored?.token) {
        try {
          const freshUser = await getCurrentUser();
          setUser(freshUser);
          writeStoredAuth({ ...stored, user: freshUser });
        } catch {
          clearStoredAuth();
          setAuth(undefined);
          setUser(undefined);
        }
      }
      setLoading(false);
    };

    initAuth();
  }, []);

  const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await loginUser(email, password);
      const authModel: AuthModel = {
        token: data.token,
        refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
        user: data.user,
      };
      writeStoredAuth(authModel);
      setAuth(authModel);
      setUser(data.user);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await logoutUser();
    } catch {
      // Proceed with local cleanup even if server request fails
    } finally {
      clearStoredAuth();
      setAuth(undefined);
      setUser(undefined);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const register = useCallback(
    async (username: string, email: string, password: string) => {
      return await registerUser(username, email, password);
    },
    [],
  );

  const isAdmin =
    user?.role === "ADMIN" || user?.email?.includes("admin") || false;

  if (loading && !auth?.token) {
    return <ScreenLoader />;
  }

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        login,
        logout,
        register,
        auth,
        user,
        isAdmin,
        loading,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@/auth/context/auth-context";
import ScreenLoader from "@/components/ui/screen-loader";
import type { T_Role } from "@/lib/models";

interface RequireAuthProps {
  allowedRoles?: T_Role[];
}

export function RequireAuth({ allowedRoles }: RequireAuthProps) {
  const { auth, user, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (loading) {
    return <ScreenLoader />;
  }

  if (!auth?.token) {
    return (
      <Navigate
        to={`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname)}`}
        replace
      />
    );
  }

  if (allowedRoles && allowedRoles.length > 0) {
    const userRole = user?.role;
    if (!userRole || !allowedRoles.includes(userRole)) {
      return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
    }
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}

};

function visibleFor(role?: string): NavItemType[] {
  if (!role) return [];
  const set = PERMISSION_BY_ROLE[role];
  if (!set) return [];
  return NAV_ITEMS.filter((item) => set.has(item.permission));
}

export default function AppSidebarMenu() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { state } = useSidebar();
  const items = visibleFor(user?.role);
  if (!user?.role) return null;

  return (
    <Sidebar variant="sidebar" collapsible="icon">
      <SidebarHeader>
        <SidebarMenu>
          <SidebarMenuItem>
            {state === "expanded" && (
              <SidebarMenuButton className="w-full flex justify-between">
                <span className="font-semibold">School Management</span>
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            )}
            {!state && (
              <SidebarMenuButton className="w-full justify-center">
                <LayoutDashboard className="h-5 w-5" />
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            )}
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarHeader>

      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <SidebarMenu>
            {items.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const isActive = location.pathname === item.href;
              return (
                <SidebarMenuItem key={item.key}>
                  <Link to={item.href} onClick={() => state === "collapsed" && {}}
                    className={isActive ? "bg-sidebar-accent" : ""}>
                    <SidebarMenuButton
                      tooltip={item.label}
                      className={isActive ? "data-active:bg-sidebar-accent data-active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground" : ""}
                    >
                      <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                      <span>{item.label}</span>
                    </SidebarMenuButton>
                  </Link>
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              );
            })}
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>

      <SidebarFooter>
        <SidebarMenu>
          <SidebarMenuItem>
            <SidebarMenuButton
              tooltip="Logout"
              onClick={() => useAuth.getState?.().logout?.()}
            >
              <svg
                xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                width="16"
                height="16"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                className="lucide lucide-log-out"
              >
                <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"></path>
                <polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"></polyline>
                <line x1="10" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line>
              </svg>
              <span>Logout</span>
            </SidebarMenuButton>
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarFooter>
    </Sidebar>
  );
}

import { AxiosError, type AxiosResponse } from "axios";

export type T_AxiosResponseWithoutPagination<T> = AxiosResponse<{
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  code: number;
  data: T;
}>;
export type T_AxiosResponseWithoutAnything = AxiosResponse<{
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  code: number;
}>;
export type T_AxiosResponseWithPagination<T> = AxiosResponse<{
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  code: number;
  data: {
    data: T[];
    pagination: {
      limit: number;
      page: number;
      total: number;
    };
  };
}>;

export type T_Response<T_Data> = {
  success: boolean;
  status: number;
  message: string;
  // pagination?: T_PaginatedResponse;
  data: T_Data;
};
export type T_ValidationError = T_Response<{
  [key: string]: string[];
}>;
export type T_UseQueryError = T_ValidationError | T_Response<[]>;
export type T_MutationError = AxiosError<T_UseQueryError>;

export type T_ApiParams = {
  search?: string;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
};

export type T_TableHead = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
};

          // Fallback for any unregistered path
          { path: "/*", element: <DefaultRedirect /> },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },

  { path: "/", element: <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace /> },
  { path: "*", element: <ForbiddenPage /> },
]);

function DefaultRedirect() {
  return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
}

function AppRoutingSetup() {
  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <RouterProvider router={router} />
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}
export default AppRoutingSetup;

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])
```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])
```
